joplin共享笔记本实时协作编辑.display_title: Add real-time collaboration to shared notebooks
joplin共享笔记本实时协作编辑.display_description: Enable secure, convergent real-time Markdown editing for eligible shared notebooks while preserving offline sync and unsupported-editor behavior.
joplin共享笔记本实时协作编辑.instruction_en: Implement real-time collaborative editing for notes in accepted, writable shared notebooks. Limit support to the desktop CodeMirror 6 Markdown editor and the mobile Markdown editor; unsupported editors, direct note shares, published folders, unshared notes, and end-to-end encrypted notebooks must keep existing behavior. Authenticate every session and revalidate notebook ownership, invitation state, and write permission on the server. Support deduplicated incremental edits, cursors, selections, saves, leave, and heartbeat events with deterministic convergence for concurrent and out-of-order operations. Show remote cursors and unsaved remote changes without disturbing local selections, then clear them after commit, discard, or expiry. Autosave and manual save must persist through the normal note path only after a successful collaborative commit. Preserve local drafts and expose failures across conflicts, permission revocation, disconnects, and restarts. Add deterministic tests using fake transports, clocks, users, and shared-notebook fixtures, plus user-facing protocol and fallback documentation.
joplin共享笔记本实时协作编辑.install_block:
# Joplin is a yarn-4 monorepo whose root postinstall (`husky && gulp build`) compiles every
# workspace. Those gulp tasks need rsync=3.2.7-1+deb12u6 (app-cli/tools) and keytar needs libsecret, neither of
# which mars-base ships. HUSKY=0 turns the hook installer into a no-op; the repo's own
# .yarn/releases/yarn-4.16.0.cjs is used via yarnPath, so corepack is not required. The clipper
# build rewrites a tracked lockfile, restored afterwards so the checkout stays pristine.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends rsync=3.2.7-1+deb12u6 libsecret-1-dev=0.20.5-3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# BUILD_SEQUENCIAL=1 is Joplin's own CI switch: build workspaces one at a time instead of two in
# parallel, which keeps peak memory inside the 8 GB deep-swe container limit.
ENV NODE_ENV=development NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false HUSKY=0 YARN_ENABLE_INLINE_BUILDS=1 BUILD_SEQUENCIAL=1
RUN yarn install --immutable
# Separate layer: the checkout/cleanliness check runs in a fresh process after the workspace
# build has released its memory.
RUN git checkout -- . && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

为 MyBatis-Plus 增加基于注解和请求语言的 i18n 字段自动翻译能.display_description: Provide an optional Spring Web extension that maps translated table fields onto returned objects according to the request language.
为 MyBatis-Plus 增加基于注解和请求语言的 i18n 字段自动翻译能.instruction_en: Add an optional, Java 8 compatible i18n extension for MyBatis-Plus. Public annotations and APIs must describe the translation table, join key, language column, and explicit object-property-to-column mappings. An opt-in Spring Web integration must choose a non-empty lang request parameter before a non-empty Language header and translate single objects, collections, and page records before serialization. Missing language context, join keys, rows, or null translated values must preserve original values; undeclared fields and pagination metadata must not change. Avoid cross-object and cross-request state leakage and cache immutable reflection metadata rather than resolving annotations per field. Keep all behavior unchanged when the extension is not enabled. Document registration and fallback semantics and add repeatable tests with the existing test infrastructure and an in-memory database or mocked request context.

为 MyBatis Generator 增加无副作用的代码生成 plan/che.display_description: Preview MyBatis Generator outputs through Java, CLI, and Maven interfaces without changing the target tree.
为 MyBatis Generator 增加无副作用的代码生成 plan/che.install_block:
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-17-jdk-headless=17.0.20.1+1-1~deb12u1 maven=3.8.7-1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN cd core && mvn -q -DskipTests dependency:go-offline
为 MyBatis Generator 增加无副作用的代码生成 plan/che.instruction_en: Add a side-effect-free plan/check mode that executes normal validation, introspection, plugin, generation, merge, formatting, encoding, overwrite, and alternate-name rules without changing the target directory. Expose a reusable Java API whose ordered plan covers Java, Kotlin, XML, and generic files and reports final path, encoding, warning, digest, and one of NEW, UPDATED, UNCHANGED, SAVED_AS_NEW, or SKIPPED. Model earlier virtual writes so same-run path collisions and .1 names match a subsequent real generation exactly. The CLI must distinguish clean, drift, and execution failure and optionally emit stable JSON; the Maven plugin must provide equivalent opt-in behavior. Cancellation and progress must work without reporting saves or refreshes. Add tests for merges, encodings, collisions, cancellation, failures, byte-for-byte prediction, and proof that planning leaves the tree unchanged. Preserve all existing behavior when disabled and add no runtime dependency.

为 Ant Design 新增全局命令面板组件.display_title: Add a global command palette component
为 Ant Design 新增全局命令面板组件.display_description: Provide an accessible, searchable command palette with nested commands, async results, shortcuts, and Ant Design theme integration.
为 Ant Design 新增全局命令面板组件.instruction_en: Add a public Ant Design command palette component with complete types, exports, documentation, and examples. Support controlled and uncontrolled open and search state, configurable activation shortcuts, grouped and disabled commands, shortcut hints, and nested command levels. Keyboard navigation must skip disabled items, Enter must execute or descend, Escape must go back or close, and returning to a parent must restore its query, selection, and scroll position. Support local commands plus asynchronously supplied results with loading, empty, and failure states; stale requests must never replace newer results. Restore focus to the opener on close and provide correct dialog, combobox, active-descendant, live-region, and screen-reader behavior. Integrate with themes, localization, RTL, portals, and virtualized large result sets without stealing keystrokes from normal text inputs. Add focused component, interaction, accessibility, async-race, and regression tests.

PDFBox 可回滚文档编辑事务与嵌套保存点.display_description: Provide document editing transactions with nested savepoints, deterministic rollback, and compatibility with existing PDFBox saves.
PDFBox 可回滚文档编辑事务与嵌套保存点.instruction_en: Add an opt-in transaction API for PDF document mutations. A transaction must support commit, rollback, and nested savepoints while covering page trees, COS objects, streams, metadata, resources, annotations, forms, and other changes made through existing public editing APIs. Rolling back must restore the exact observable pre-transaction document state, including object identity relationships and dirty flags needed by later full or incremental saves; committed changes must save normally. Inner savepoints may commit into or roll back independently of the outer transaction, while an outer rollback removes all nested work. Reject invalid lifecycle operations deterministically and make cleanup safe with exceptions and try-with-resources. Existing non-transactional behavior must remain unchanged. Add tests for nested edits, stream replacement, indirect objects, incremental saves, exceptions, invalid lifecycles, and byte/semantic equivalence after rollback, and document the scope and resource rules.

PPTist 编辑历史快照的异步一致性.display_description: Keep undo and redo snapshots ordered and immutable when slide edits and asynchronous asset updates overlap.
PPTist 编辑历史快照的异步一致性.instruction_en: Make PPTist history capture safe when synchronous edits overlap asynchronous updates such as image loading, uploads, and element replacement. Each committed user action must produce one immutable snapshot in logical action order, even when completion order differs. Undo and redo must never expose a partially mutated state, merge unrelated actions, resurrect stale async results, or corrupt the current slide selection. New edits after undo must discard only the correct redo branch. Define cancellation and stale-result handling when a document, slide, or element is removed before an async operation completes. Preserve existing synchronous history behavior and storage format where possible. Add deterministic tests with controlled promises for out-of-order completion, rapid repeated edits, undo during pending work, redo invalidation, deletion, and snapshot immutability, and update the relevant developer documentation.

让供应商消费上限参与代理路由与自动故障转移.display_description: Use provider budget limits and measured spend when routing requests and failing over between configured upstreams.
让供应商消费上限参与代理路由与自动故障转移.instruction_en: Extend provider routing so configured spending limits and recorded usage participate in provider selection and automatic failover. Support explicit budget windows, deterministic remaining-budget calculation, and clear states for available, near-limit, exhausted, stale, or unavailable usage data. Do not route new work to an exhausted provider; when an in-flight request reveals a limit response, classify it and retry only when the operation is safe under existing retry rules. Preserve provider priority among eligible choices and avoid oscillation or concurrent overspend when multiple requests reserve capacity. Configuration, status output, and diagnostics must expose the effective limit, window, usage source, and failover reason without revealing credentials. Missing limits must retain current routing behavior. Add tests with fake clocks, concurrent requests, window rollover, stale data, failed usage lookups, retry safety, and stable selection.

让 yt-dlp 的下载归档记住失败项.display_title: Record failed downloads in the archive
让 yt-dlp 的下载归档记住失败项.display_description: Optionally persist failed archive entries so repeated runs can skip or retry them with clear compatibility semantics.
让 yt-dlp 的下载归档记住失败项.instruction_en: Add an opt-in way for yt-dlp download archives to record failed items as distinct from successful downloads. The archive format and reader must distinguish status without breaking existing successful-entry files, deduplicate repeated writes, and remain safe with concurrent or interrupted processes using the project’s existing archive guarantees. Provide options that control whether previously failed entries are skipped or retried, while successful entries always retain current skip behavior. A later successful retry must supersede the failed state deterministically. Only terminal item failures should be recorded; extraction retries, simulation, listing, and unrelated playlist failures must follow documented semantics. Update console messages, help text, and documentation, and add tests for legacy archives, mixed status entries, retry-to-success, duplicate/concurrent writes, playlist behavior, and disabled-mode compatibility.

给 Graphify 的语言 Extractor 增加插件机制.display_description: Allow third-party language extractors to register safely without changing Graphify core or built-in extraction behavior.
给 Graphify 的语言 Extractor 增加插件机制.instruction_en: Introduce a documented plugin mechanism for Graphify language extractors. Plugins must declare stable language identifiers and create extractors through a public interface, with deterministic discovery and explicit handling for duplicate names, unsupported versions, import failures, and malformed plugins. Built-in extractors must remain available and keep precedence according to a documented rule. Discovery should be lazy enough that an unrelated broken plugin does not prevent normal startup, while selecting that plugin produces an actionable error. Keep plugin failures isolated across files and avoid mutable global state leaking between runs. Provide a practical entry-point registration example and tests using temporary distributions or injectable discovery for successful registration, conflicts, lazy load failures, compatibility checks, built-in fallback, and repeatable ordering.

为大文件上传提供断点续传与幂等分片.display_description: Support authenticated resumable uploads whose chunks can be retried safely and assembled without duplicate or corrupted files.
为大文件上传提供断点续传与幂等分片.instruction_en: Add a resumable chunked-upload protocol for large Gradio files while preserving the existing upload path. Create an upload session with authenticated ownership, declared size and metadata, accept bounded chunks with offsets or indexes and integrity information, and make exact retries idempotent. Reject conflicting duplicates, overlaps, gaps, oversized data, expired sessions, and cross-user access without exposing temporary paths. Finalization must atomically assemble and validate exactly one normal Gradio upload result; concurrent finalization must not duplicate output. Cancellation, expiry, disconnects, and server errors must clean temporary resources, while a resumable client can query received ranges after reconnecting. Apply existing file-type, size, and security checks to the completed file. Add deterministic API and client tests for retries, out-of-order chunks, corruption, authorization, races, restart-compatible state where supported, cleanup, and legacy-upload compatibility, plus protocol documentation.
为大文件上传提供断点续传与幂等分片.install_block:
# pip-compile layout: test/requirements.in is the requirement set and test/requirements.txt its lock,
# compiled by upstream for Python 3.10 (it pins packages that do not exist for 3.12). Installing the
# .in set with the lock as constraints keeps every applicable pin while skipping inapplicable ones.
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r test/requirements.in -c test/requirements.txt -e . \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

为 Requests Session 增加默认请求超时.display_title: Add a default timeout to Requests sessions
为 Requests Session 增加默认请求超时.display_description: Let a Session supply a default timeout while preserving per-request overrides and existing Requests behavior by default.
为 Requests Session 增加默认请求超时.instruction_en: Allow requests.Session to define an optional default timeout used by every request that does not explicitly supply one. The default must accept the same values and validation as the current per-request timeout and flow through redirects, prepared requests, adapters, and convenience methods exactly as an explicit timeout would. An explicit request timeout, including an explicit None, must override the session default. Sessions without a configured default must retain today’s unlimited-timeout behavior and public call compatibility. Ensure copied, pickled, and subclassed sessions behave consistently and do not leak settings between instances. Document precedence and examples and add tests for scalar and tuple values, explicit overrides, redirects, adapters, invalid inputs, serialization, and unchanged default behavior without relying on real network timing.

已定位到分片的父行，二次加载不能扫全部库.display_title: Keep parent refreshes on the selected shard
已定位到分片的父行，二次加载不能扫全部库.display_description: Prevent relationship-driven refreshes of an already located parent row from querying every configured SQLAlchemy shard.
已定位到分片的父行，二次加载不能扫全部库.instruction_en: Fix SQLAlchemy horizontal sharding so a parent instance already associated with a shard keeps that identity token during secondary loads and refreshes. Expired scalar attributes, lazy relationship access, select-in and joined loading, refresh, and merge paths must target the known shard instead of broadcasting to every shard. Objects with no shard identity must retain current chooser behavior, and explicitly supplied chooser or execution options must keep their documented precedence. Identity-map keys must continue to distinguish equal primary keys on different shards without cross-populating relationships. Add tests with instrumented shard engines that assert the exact databases queried for located and unlocated objects, expiration, eager and lazy loading, merge/detach flows, missing rows, and same-primary-key records. Preserve non-sharded ORM behavior.

质询重试必须带上同一次响应里新发的 cookie.display_title: Apply response cookies to challenge retries
质询重试必须带上同一次响应里新发的 cookie.display_description: Ensure aiohttp authentication challenge retries include cookies set by the challenge response without leaking them across origins.
质询重试必须带上同一次响应里新发的 cookie.instruction_en: Fix aiohttp challenge-driven request retries so cookies set by the 401 or 407 response are available to the retry produced from that same response. Update the configured cookie jar before constructing retry headers while preserving domain, path, secure, expiry, SameSite, redirect, and unsafe-cookie rules. Do not copy raw Set-Cookie values or leak origin cookies to a proxy, proxy cookies to an origin, or cookies across redirects and hosts. Repeated challenges must not duplicate Cookie header values or loop beyond existing retry limits. Requests without a cookie jar, challenge, or retry must keep current behavior. Add deterministic tests for origin and proxy authentication, multiple cookies, replacements and deletions, redirects, disabled jars, malformed cookies, retry limits, and cross-origin isolation.
质询重试必须带上同一次响应里新发的 cookie.install_block:
# aiohttp keeps only Cython sources in git; its C extensions need `make cythonize` plus llhttp
# generated through npm. Upstream CI tests the pure-Python implementation in a no-extensions
# matrix, so build that variant. requirements/test.in + test.txt are installed as requirements +
# constraints (the upstream idiom): pins that do not apply to CPython 3.12 are skipped.
ENV AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS=1
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements/test.in -c requirements/test.txt -e . \
    && python -c "import aiohttp, pytest" \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

握手阶段改过的会话必须写回给后续 HTTP.display_description: Write session mutations made during a WebSocket handshake back to the client for subsequent HTTP requests.
握手阶段改过的会话必须写回给后续 HTTP.instruction_en: Update Starlette session handling so mutations performed while accepting a WebSocket can be persisted for later HTTP requests. Reuse the existing signed session format, secret, cookie options, and deletion semantics, and make the resulting Set-Cookie available during the HTTP upgrade response without corrupting normal WebSocket headers. Unchanged sessions must not emit unnecessary cookies. Session clearing, invalid incoming cookies, denied handshakes, exceptions before acceptance, and attempts to mutate after the response is committed must have deterministic behavior. HTTP session middleware and applications without SessionMiddleware must remain unchanged. Add ASGI-level tests that capture upgrade headers and then issue an HTTP request with the returned cookie, covering set, update, clear, unchanged, rejection, invalid signatures, and configured cookie attributes, and document the supported lifecycle.

为 HTTPX 增加可配置的响应体大小上限.display_title: Add configurable response body size limits
为 HTTPX 增加可配置的响应体大小上限.display_description: Bound HTTPX response bodies consistently for streamed, buffered, compressed, synchronous, and asynchronous requests.
为 HTTPX 增加可配置的响应体大小上限.instruction_en: Add an optional maximum response-body size to HTTPX clients and per-request APIs, with per-request values overriding client defaults and no limit preserving current behavior. Enforce the limit on decoded bytes actually exposed to callers for buffered and streamed responses, including compressed, chunked, HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, sync, and async paths. Reject an already excessive trustworthy Content-Length early, but still enforce incrementally when length is missing, misleading, or compression expands the body. On overflow, raise one documented HTTPX exception carrying request context, close or discard the response and connection safely, and never return a partial buffered body as success. Streaming callers may receive chunks up to the boundary before the next read fails deterministically. Validate negative or invalid limits. Add transport-level deterministic tests for precedence, exact-boundary success, compression, misleading headers, iteration APIs, cleanup, and disabled compatibility.

为 pydantic-settings 增加字段级配置来源追踪能力.display_title: Track each settings field value source
为 pydantic-settings 增加字段级配置来源追踪能力.display_description: Expose where every final pydantic-settings field value originated, including nested and merged configuration sources.
为 pydantic-settings 增加字段级配置来源追踪能力.instruction_en: Add an opt-in public API that explains the source of each final pydantic-settings field value. Track source identity and the relevant external key across initialization arguments, environment variables, dotenv, secrets, CLI, defaults, aliases, nested delimiters, and custom sources while preserving existing source precedence and validation. For merged nested models, report provenance at the leaf level so values assembled from different sources remain distinguishable; overridden candidates must not be reported as winners. Do not expose secret values, file contents, or sensitive environment data in provenance or errors. Custom sources need a backwards-compatible way to supply metadata, while legacy sources continue to work with an identifiable fallback. Keep normal model equality, dump, schema, serialization, and performance behavior unchanged when tracking is unused. Add tests for aliases, nested merges, validation failures, secrets, custom sources, and concurrent instances, and document the API and security model.

聚合或条件里嵌整表时，生成类型不能退化成无结构值.display_title: Preserve embedded table types in expressions
聚合或条件里嵌整表时，生成类型不能退化成无结构值.display_description: Keep structured generated models when whole-table values appear inside aggregate or conditional SQL expressions.
聚合或条件里嵌整表时，生成类型不能退化成无结构值.instruction_en: Fix sqlc type analysis so a whole table or table alias embedded inside aggregate and conditional expressions retains its generated structured model instead of degrading to an untyped value. Cover supported forms such as row values passed through aggregates, CASE branches, COALESCE, FILTER clauses, window expressions, aliases, and nullable outer joins according to each SQL engine’s existing capabilities. The generated field type, nullability, name, imports, and query decoding must remain stable and match direct whole-table embedding. Scalar columns and genuinely anonymous records must keep current inference. Add parser/compiler and end-to-end generation fixtures for supported engines, nested expressions, aliases, nullability, mixed incompatible branches, and regressions in existing output. Do not special-case query text or introduce engine behavior that the underlying parser cannot represent.

为 pytest 增加测试选择原因说明模式.display_title: Explain why pytest selected each test
为 pytest 增加测试选择原因说明模式.display_description: Add a deterministic collection mode that reports how selectors, markers, keywords, ignores, and deselection affected tests.
为 pytest 增加测试选择原因说明模式.instruction_en: Add an opt-in pytest mode that explains why collected tests were selected, deselected, or ignored. Report the relevant command-line path or node id, keyword expression, marker expression, ignore rule, collection hook, and explicit deselection in a stable, readable form, with an optional machine-readable output suitable for CI. Explanations must reflect the actual collection and selection pipeline rather than reimplementing it, handle parametrized nodes and plugins, and avoid executing tests. Normal collection output, exit codes, hook ordering, and performance must remain unchanged when the mode is off. Plugin-provided selection changes should be attributable without exposing arbitrary object reprs or producing nondeterministic ordering. Add tests for combined selectors, parametrization, collection errors, custom hooks, quiet/verbose modes, JSON stability, and default compatibility, and document the format and limitations.

为 FastAPI 增加可选的 Problem Details 错误响应.display_title: Add optional Problem Details error responses
为 FastAPI 增加可选的 Problem Details 错误响应.display_description: Let FastAPI emit RFC-style problem detail documents for framework and application errors without changing defaults.
为 FastAPI 增加可选的 Problem Details 错误响应.instruction_en: Add opt-in Problem Details responses to FastAPI for validation errors, HTTP exceptions, and registered application exceptions. Produce the application/problem+json media type with stable type, title, status, detail, and instance members, plus safe structured extensions where configured. Preserve response headers and status codes, exclude sensitive exception internals by default, and correctly handle nested validation locations. Allow application- and router-level configuration with clear precedence and an extension point for custom problem types. Existing exception handlers and explicitly returned responses must win, OpenAPI must describe enabled problem responses without duplicating components, and behavior must be unchanged when disabled. Add tests for sync and async handlers, validation, custom headers, mounted/router configurations, custom handlers, debug mode, OpenAPI, and backward compatibility, and document migration and security considerations.

热加载主文件后，先前合并进来的键不能丢.display_title: Preserve merged values during hot reload
热加载主文件后，先前合并进来的键不能丢.display_description: Reload Viper's primary config file without discarding values previously merged from files, maps, flags, or environment sources.
热加载主文件后，先前合并进来的键不能丢.instruction_en: Fix Viper configuration watching so reloading the primary config file does not discard values previously merged through MergeConfig, MergeConfigMap, or other established sources. Rebuild the effective configuration with the same precedence as before the watch event: changed primary-file values update, removed primary-file keys disappear only when not supplied elsewhere, and merged values remain. Repeated events must not accumulate stale values or mutate caller-owned maps. Invalid or partially written files must leave the last good effective state intact and allow a later valid event to recover, with callbacks observing only committed snapshots. Preserve aliases, key delimiters, case-insensitive lookup, flags, environment overrides, remote providers, and behavior when watching is unused. Add deterministic fake-event tests for updates, deletions, merges, parse failures, rapid events, and races.

改写返回旧行时，嵌入整表必须还能认出原来的模型.display_title: Preserve table models in old-row returns
改写返回旧行时，嵌入整表必须还能认出原来的模型.display_description: Generate the original table model when rewritten mutation queries return embedded old-row values.
改写返回旧行时，嵌入整表必须还能认出原来的模型.instruction_en: Fix sqlc analysis and rewriting for mutation queries that capture or return the old row and embed an entire table value. The generated result must use the existing table model, including field names, types, nullability, overrides, renames, and engine-specific decoding, rather than an anonymous or unstructured value. Preserve the model through CTEs, aliases, rewritten RETURNING clauses, and combinations with explicitly returned scalar columns. New-row behavior and ordinary SELECT embedding must not regress. When a dialect cannot represent the requested old-row form, return a clear compiler diagnostic rather than silently degrading the type. Add parser, rewrite, code-generation, and end-to-end fixtures across supported engines for aliases, composite keys, nullable fields, overrides, mixed old/new values, and unchanged existing output.

为 Alembic autogenerate 增加自定义索引比较入口.display_description: Let Alembic users customize index equivalence during autogenerate while retaining dialect-aware default comparison.
为 Alembic autogenerate 增加自定义索引比较入口.instruction_en: Add a public autogenerate hook for comparing a metadata Index with the reflected database index. The hook must receive enough migration and dialect context to return equal, different, or defer to Alembic’s normal comparison. Apply it consistently to changed, added, removed, renamed, expression, partial, unique, and dialect-option indexes without changing table or constraint comparison. Default behavior must be byte-for-byte compatible when no hook is registered. Multiple hooks or rewriters need deterministic ordering and errors must include the table and index involved. Avoid calling user hooks for unrelated objects and do not mutate reflected or metadata objects. Add tests for include/exclude filters, schema-qualified tables, naming conventions, batch mode, offline generation where applicable, custom decisions, deferral, errors, and existing dialect behavior, plus API documentation and examples.

Datasette 异构数据源统一管理与 Web 读写契约.display_description: Expose a unified, permission-aware web contract for registered read-only and writable non-SQLite data sources.
Datasette 异构数据源统一管理与 Web 读写契约.instruction_en: Introduce a public data-source abstraction that lets Datasette register heterogeneous backends alongside SQLite. Provide stable discovery and metadata, table and row reads, filtering, sorting, pagination, and an explicitly opt-in write contract with create, update, delete, transactions, and capability reporting. The web and JSON APIs must route through the abstraction, enforce existing actor and permission checks, validate identifiers and values, and return consistent errors for unsupported capabilities. Read-only sources must never receive writes. Plugins must be isolated, deterministically named, and able to clean up resources; one failing source must not break unrelated databases. Keep existing SQLite routes, templates, URLs, SQL behavior, and plugin hooks unchanged. Add an in-memory fake source and tests for mixed sources, permissions, pagination tokens, writes and rollback, unsupported operations, failure isolation, and backwards compatibility, plus author documentation.

JDBC/FTP/WebSocket 协议接入与 HAR 一键脚本生成.display_title: Add protocol clients and HAR script import
JDBC/FTP/WebSocket 协议接入与 HAR 一键脚本生成.display_description: Extend Locust with JDBC, FTP, and WebSocket clients plus deterministic HAR-to-load-test generation.
JDBC/FTP/WebSocket 协议接入与 HAR 一键脚本生成.instruction_en: Add optional JDBC, FTP, and WebSocket client integrations that follow Locust’s request event, timing, naming, success/failure, user lifecycle, and statistics conventions. Protocol dependencies must remain optional and missing extras must produce actionable import errors without affecting HTTP users. Ensure connections close on user stop and failures cannot leak credentials in logs. Also add a HAR importer that generates a deterministic, editable Locust script from requests in archive order, preserving methods, URLs, safe headers, query parameters, and bodies while redacting secrets and representing unsupported entries clearly. Generated names and grouping must be stable and syntax-valid. Add fake-client tests for timing, errors, reconnect and cleanup plus fixture-based HAR tests for redirects, binary content, cookies, redaction, duplicate URLs, and stable output. Document installation extras, APIs, limitations, and security behavior.

窗口和过滤条件里的参数不能串类型.display_title: Keep parameter types isolated in window filters
窗口和过滤条件里的参数不能串类型.display_description: Infer SQL parameters in FILTER and window clauses from their own expressions without leaking types between placeholders.
窗口和过滤条件里的参数不能串类型.instruction_en: Fix sqlc parameter type inference for placeholders used inside aggregate FILTER predicates and window specifications. Each parameter must derive type and nullability from its own operator, column, cast, or function context; parameters in PARTITION BY, ORDER BY, frame bounds, FILTER, and the surrounding expression must not accidentally share another placeholder’s inferred type. Reused named parameters should unify only when they refer to the same logical parameter and should report a clear error for incompatible contexts. Preserve numbering and generated parameter order for positional and named placeholders across supported SQL engines. Add compiler and generated-code fixtures for mixed numeric, text, timestamp, nullable, cast, frame, and repeated-name cases, nested windows, and regressions. Existing non-window inference and query output must remain unchanged.

yt-dlp GUI 全选项桥接与音视频依赖管理.display_title: Bridge yt-dlp options into a desktop GUI
yt-dlp GUI 全选项桥接与音视频依赖管理.display_description: Provide a maintainable GUI option model and safe FFmpeg dependency handling without diverging from yt-dlp's CLI semantics.
yt-dlp GUI 全选项桥接与音视频依赖管理.instruction_en: Add a desktop GUI integration that can represent and validate yt-dlp’s supported public options without duplicating their semantics. Organize options into searchable groups, preserve typed values and repeatable arguments, generate a previewable command/config deterministically, and round-trip existing configuration where possible. Long-running downloads must expose progress, cancellation, playlist items, warnings, and errors without blocking the UI or leaking credentials. Detect FFmpeg and related media dependencies, explain which requested operations require them, allow an explicit executable location, and degrade safely when unavailable; do not silently download or execute untrusted binaries. Keep the CLI and Python API unchanged. Add tests around the option model, command serialization and quoting, config migration, dependency detection, cancellation, progress event ordering, and secret redaction, plus user and contributor documentation.

给车队做一次可撤销的里程账本校正.display_description: Record auditable mileage corrections that can be previewed, applied atomically, and reversed without rewriting history.
给车队做一次可撤销的里程账本校正.instruction_en: Add a mileage-ledger correction workflow for fleet records. A correction must identify the vehicle, affected reading or range, old and new values, reason, actor, and time, validate odometer monotonicity and downstream effects, and provide a dry-run preview before atomic application. Never rewrite or delete the original ledger event; store an auditable compensating record and recalculate derived mileage, service intervals, and cost metrics consistently. Reversal must create another explicit event, be idempotent, and reject stale or already reversed corrections. Concurrent edits must not produce partial recalculation or lost updates. Existing uncorrected data and imports must remain compatible. Add tests for preview, apply, reversal, chains, invalid decreases, missing vehicles, concurrent changes, derived totals, serialization, and audit output, and document operator recovery steps.

车队数据在多设备之间可靠同步.display_description: Add resumable, conflict-aware synchronization for fleet records edited on multiple offline-capable devices.
车队数据在多设备之间可靠同步.instruction_en: Implement multi-device synchronization for May fleet data. Represent local mutations with stable operation IDs and versions, exchange changes incrementally with a resumable cursor, and make replay idempotent across disconnects and retries. Concurrent edits must follow documented deterministic conflict rules: merge independent fields and records, preserve both append-only events, and surface irreconcilable changes without silently overwriting data. Deletes, corrections, attachments or references, and schema-version upgrades need explicit behavior. Authentication and device identity must prevent one account from reading or writing another’s fleet, and logs must not expose sensitive data. Keep single-device storage and existing files compatible when sync is unused. Add a fake transport and clock plus tests for first sync, offline edits, retries, reordering, duplicate operations, conflicts, deletion, cursor loss, migration, and convergence among three devices, with user-facing status and recovery documentation.

把维护、提醒和费用变成一个可交接的运营队列.display_title: Create a handoff-ready fleet operations queue
把维护、提醒和费用变成一个可交接的运营队列.display_description: Unify maintenance work, reminders, and costs in an auditable queue with ownership, transitions, and recovery.
把维护、提醒和费用变成一个可交接的运营队列.instruction_en: Add an operations queue that turns fleet maintenance, reminders, and expense follow-ups into durable work items. Items need stable identity, vehicle and source references, type, priority, due time, status, assignee, notes, costs, and an append-only transition history. Provide filtered and ordered views, claim and handoff operations, completion and reopen flows, and idempotent creation from recurring reminders so retries do not duplicate work. Enforce valid transitions and prevent concurrent claims or updates from losing data. Completing maintenance should update the related service state and cost records atomically; failures must leave a recoverable queue item. Preserve existing reminder and expense behavior for users who do not use the queue. Add tests for ordering, filters, recurrence, handoffs, concurrent claims, partial failures, vehicle deletion, serialization, and audit history, and document the workflow.

Pydantic model_copy 支持校验更新值.display_description: Offer an opt-in model_copy mode that validates updated values while retaining normal copy semantics by default.
Pydantic model_copy 支持校验更新值.instruction_en: Add an explicit opt-in option for BaseModel.model_copy that validates values supplied through update before constructing the copy. Validation must use the model’s normal field, model, alias, extra-field, strictness, generic, private-attribute, and computed-field semantics, while untouched values retain the current shallow or deep copy behavior. Validation errors must use standard Pydantic locations and types. Handle frozen models, root models, nested models, fields_set, extra values, and deep=True consistently, and do not mutate the original or the caller’s update mapping. The default unvalidated fast path and its performance and compatibility must remain unchanged. Document when validation occurs and how it differs from model_validate, and add tests for coercion, validators, aliases, extras, nested updates, invalid data, shallow/deep copies, generics, frozen models, and default behavior.

为 Gitea 增加组织级分支保护策略.display_description: Define organization policies that apply consistent branch protection to matching repositories with safe overrides and reconciliation.
为 Gitea 增加组织级分支保护策略.instruction_en: Add organization-level branch protection policies that target repositories and branches through explicit patterns. Policies must expose the existing protection controls, define deterministic precedence with repository-level rules, and reconcile additions, edits, disables, and deletions without weakening unrelated protections. Provide permission-checked API and web management, dry-run impact reporting, audit events, pagination, and clear conflict diagnostics. Repository creation, transfer into or out of an organization, rename, archive, and policy pattern changes must converge to the expected effective rules. Concurrent reconciliation must be idempotent and must not expose a partially applied policy; failures need retryable status. Existing per-repository branch protection and organizations without policies must retain current behavior. Add model, service, API, permission, migration, and integration tests for precedence, patterns, transfers, failures, and race-safe reconciliation, plus administrator documentation.

模型流式中途失败没有收尾事件.display_title: Emit final events for failed model streams
模型流式中途失败没有收尾事件.display_description: Close LangChain streaming traces with a single structured terminal error event when a model fails mid-stream.
模型流式中途失败没有收尾事件.install_block:
# langchain-core is its own uv project (libs/core/uv.lock with a `test` dependency group, which is what
# upstream CI syncs). mars-base's uv 0.9.18 cannot read this lockfile; the environment lives outside /app.
ENV UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "uv==0.12.9" \
    && cd libs/core \
    && python -m uv sync --frozen --no-default-groups --group test \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}"
模型流式中途失败没有收尾事件.instruction_en: Fix LangChain streaming so a model or provider failure after partial output always produces exactly one terminal error event for the logical run. The event must preserve run, parent, tags, metadata, and callback ordering; carry the original exception through existing error callbacks; and never be followed by a normal end event. Sync and async streams, iterator cancellation, consumer break or close, nested chains, retries, and callback-handler failures must clean up active runs without double termination. Tokens already yielded remain yielded, but no synthetic success result should be created. Non-streaming and successful streaming behavior must not change. Add deterministic fake-model tests for failure before and after chunks, cancellation, nested runs, retries, callback exceptions, iterator cleanup, and trace-tree completeness, and update event-schema documentation.
模型流式中途失败没有收尾事件.smoke: cd libs/core && python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -n 5

嵌入缓存未随模型规格隔离.display_description: Prevent cached embeddings from being reused across incompatible providers, models, dimensions, or effective settings.

Distinguish provider and implementation, model or deployment, dimensions, revision, and settings that can change vector output, while excluding credentials and unstable object representations. Allow custom embedding classes to provide an explicit stable namespace and preserve a documented legacy option where compatibility is required. Query and document embeddings, sync and async calls, batches, and repeated instances with equivalent configuration must use the same rules. Different specifications must never share vectors; equivalent specifications should still hit cache. Existing stores and serializers must handle versioned keys without unsafe collisions. 为 Caddy 的反向代理补充上游健康状态可观测性.display_description: Provide metrics and structured status for active and passive upstream health without changing load-balancing behavior.
为 Caddy 的反向代理补充上游健康状态可观测性.instruction_en: Add observability for Caddy reverse-proxy upstream health. Expose a permission-appropriate structured status surface and metrics showing upstream identity, active and passive health, failure count, last transition, check latency or result, and current eligibility. Updates must be race-safe and snapshots internally consistent while health checks and requests run concurrently. Avoid credentials, raw sensitive URLs, unbounded labels, and unstable upstream identifiers. Multiple routes and dynamically provisioned upstreams need deterministic aggregation and lifecycle cleanup. Observability must not trigger probes, hold request-path locks, or change selection and health semantics when unused. Add tests with fake clocks and health results for transitions, recovery, passive failures, dynamic upstream removal, concurrency, metric cardinality, and disabled compatibility, and document fields and operational interpretation.

为 seekable 增加位置检查点.display_title: Add named checkpoints to seekable iterators
为 seekable 增加位置检查点.display_description: Let more-itertools seekable callers save, restore, release, and inspect replay positions safely.
为 seekable 增加位置检查点.instruction_en: Extend more_itertools.seekable with named position checkpoints. Callers must be able to create or replace a checkpoint at the current logical position, restore it repeatedly while retained data permits, release it, and inspect available checkpoint names without mutating internal state. Cache trimming and maxlen behavior must retain data needed by active checkpoints or report deterministic expiration according to a documented policy; seeking, relative iteration, peek, truth testing, and ordinary replay must continue to work. Reject invalid names and unknown or expired checkpoints clearly. Multiple checkpoints, checkpoints at EOF, and restoration after partial replay must preserve exact element order and avoid consuming the source unexpectedly. Keep existing seekable behavior and memory bounds when no checkpoint exists. Add tests for bounded and unbounded caches, replacement, release, EOF, errors, and interaction with seek and peek, plus documentation.

HTTPX 按站点熔断.display_title: Add per-origin circuit breaking to HTTPX
HTTPX 按站点熔断.display_description: Provide an optional, concurrency-safe circuit breaker isolated by request origin and integrated with HTTPX clients.
HTTPX 按站点熔断.instruction_en: Add an optional circuit breaker to HTTPX clients, isolated by normalized request origin and overridable per request. Support closed, open, and half-open states with configurable failure threshold, reset interval, and limited probe concurrency. Count only documented transport failures and status responses; cancellations and caller errors must not poison the circuit. Opening must fail fast with a public HTTPX exception carrying request context, without acquiring a connection. After a monotonic-clock interval, allow bounded probes and close only after the configured success condition. Redirects and proxies must use the actual documented origin key, and sync and async clients must be race-safe without sharing state accidentally. Disabled configuration must preserve all current behavior. Add fake-clock and mock-transport tests for thresholds, origin isolation, recovery, concurrency, redirects, cleanup, and exception mapping, and document configuration and metrics hooks.

为 chunked 增加末批填充.display_description: Optionally pad the last more-itertools chunk to a requested size while preserving lazy iteration and existing defaults.
为 chunked 增加末批填充.instruction_en: Extend more_itertools.chunked with an optional fill value that pads only the final short chunk to size n. Preserve current output when padding is not requested and retain strict-mode behavior: incomplete input must still raise rather than be hidden by padding when strict is enabled. Padding must work lazily for finite iterables, distinguish an omitted fill option from an explicit None, avoid reading beyond what each chunk requires, and handle empty input without inventing a chunk. Keep existing validation for n and iterator exceptions. Update type hints and documentation with finite-iterator and explicit-None examples. Add tests for exact multiples, short and empty inputs, generators, strict interaction, invalid sizes, explicit None, infinite inputs consumed with islice, and backward compatibility.

选课篮子的可靠提交与撤销.display_title: Make course-cart submission reliable and reversible
选课篮子的可靠提交与撤销.display_description: Submit and undo course selections atomically with capacity, prerequisite, conflict, and idempotency guarantees.
选课篮子的可靠提交与撤销.instruction_en: Add a course cart whose submission atomically enrolls all eligible selections or returns a structured decision for each item without leaving partial state. Validate prerequisites, duplicate enrollment, time conflicts, capacity and waitlist rules against a consistent snapshot, and protect seats under concurrent submissions. Requests need idempotency keys so retries cannot double-enroll or duplicate charges and notifications. Provide a bounded undo operation that reverses only the original successful submission when downstream state still permits it, records an audit event, and safely promotes waitlisted students. Stale carts must be revalidated and failures must remain actionable. Preserve existing direct enrollment behavior. Add transaction-level tests for mixed carts, concurrency, retries, waitlists, undo, expired eligibility, downstream failures, and audit history, plus API and user documentation.

# SkyLearn pins Pillow==9.3.0 / django==4.0.8 and its CI runs Python 3.8-3.10; Pillow 9.3 has no

成绩批次草稿与可恢复发布.display_description: Stage grade batches as validated drafts and publish them idempotently with recovery from partial downstream failures.
成绩批次草稿与可恢复发布.instruction_en: Add a grade-batch draft workflow. Instructors must be able to create, edit, validate, preview, and version a draft without changing student-visible grades. Publishing must freeze a specific draft revision, apply every grade atomically where the storage boundary permits, emit notifications exactly once, and expose durable per-item progress so a process failure can resume rather than repeat completed side effects. Reject stale revisions and unauthorized course access, retain actionable validation errors, and record actor, timestamps, before/after values, and publication state without exposing other students’ data. A published draft must be immutable; correction uses a new draft. Existing direct grade paths must keep working. Add tests for permissions, validation, concurrent edits, idempotent publish, crash recovery, notification failures, large batches, audit logs, and visibility boundaries, and document operator recovery.

测验尝试的快照恢复与幂等作答.display_description: Make answer submission idempotent and restore in-progress quiz attempts without losing or duplicating responses.
测验尝试的快照恢复与幂等作答.instruction_en: Add durable snapshots for in-progress quiz attempts and idempotent answer submission. Each accepted answer operation needs a stable client operation ID, attempt revision, question identity, value, and timestamp; exact retries must return the original result while conflicting reuse is rejected. Persist consistent snapshots often enough to recover after disconnect or process restart without duplicating answers, extending time limits, or exposing correct answers. Concurrent device edits must use deterministic revision conflicts and preserve the last acknowledged client state for reconciliation. Final submission must be single-shot, validate the frozen attempt, and prevent later edits; scoring and notifications must not repeat after retries. Preserve existing quiz behavior where the new protocol is unused. Add fake-clock and restart tests for duplicate and out-of-order operations, stale revisions, expiry, concurrent devices, finalization races, scoring, and authorization, plus recovery documentation.

限制 concurrent_tee 的线程积压.display_description: Add configurable backpressure so a slow concurrent tee consumer cannot cause unbounded buffered growth.
限制 concurrent_tee 的线程积压.instruction_en: Extend concurrent_tee with an optional maximum backlog per child iterator. When one child falls behind, fast consumers must apply documented backpressure instead of growing queues without bound; no source element may be lost, duplicated, or reordered. Cancellation, close, garbage collection, source exceptions, and a consumer that permanently stops must wake blocked peers and release resources without deadlock. A nonblocking or timeout behavior may be exposed through a clear public API, but default behavior must remain compatible. Validate limits and make state transitions thread-safe under real concurrent next calls. Add deterministic synchronization-based tests for fast and slow consumers, exact bounds, source errors, abandoned children, close while blocked, multiple producers, and no thread leaks, plus documentation of ownership and blocking semantics.

HTTPX 按站点请求限速与优先级调度.display_title: Add per-origin rate and priority scheduling
HTTPX 按站点请求限速与优先级调度.display_description: Optionally schedule HTTPX requests by origin with rate limits, priorities, cancellation, and fairness.
HTTPX 按站点请求限速与优先级调度.instruction_en: Add an optional request scheduler to HTTPX clients that applies independent rate limits per normalized origin and supports a bounded priority value. Use a monotonic clock and deterministic queueing so higher-priority work can pass queued lower-priority work without starving it; preserve FIFO order among equal priorities. Waiting requests must honor pool or request timeouts according to documented semantics, cancel promptly, and never consume a permit after cancellation. Redirects, retries, proxies, HTTP/2 multiplexing, sync and async clients, client close, and transport errors must release scheduler state safely. Different origins must not block each other and disabled clients must keep current behavior. Provide injectable clock/sleep support or equivalent deterministic tests for bursts, refill, fairness, cancellation races, redirects, shutdown, and origin isolation, and document configuration and observability.

为命令组增加子命令别名.display_title: Add subcommand aliases to Click groups
为命令组增加子命令别名.display_description: Let Click commands declare discoverable aliases with deterministic resolution, help output, and collision handling.
为命令组增加子命令别名.instruction_en: Add public support for aliases on commands registered in a Click Group. Exact command names must retain precedence, aliases must resolve through normal parsing and context creation, and ambiguous or duplicate names must fail deterministically at registration with an actionable error. Help and shell completion should expose aliases in a clear, stable way without listing a command multiple times or changing output for commands without aliases. Invocation metadata should let applications distinguish the typed alias from the canonical command while callbacks and command paths retain compatible canonical behavior. Aliases must work with decorators, add_command, nested groups, chained groups where supported, command removal or replacement, and custom Group subclasses. Add tests for invocation, help widths, completion, collisions, exact-name precedence, nesting, context fields, and default compatibility, and update the documentation.

增加可组合字段转换器.display_description: Provide a public converter pipeline that composes reusable transformations with useful metadata and errors.
增加可组合字段转换器.instruction_en: Add a public attrs API for composing field converters into an ordered pipeline. The result must work anywhere an existing converter works, preserve each step’s callable semantics and type metadata where available, and expose stable introspection useful to generated signatures and documentation. Support plain functions, attrs.Converter instances, optional self or field arguments, and nesting without double-wrapping or changing evaluation order. Exceptions should identify the failing pipeline step while preserving the original exception as cause and must not leak values through repr unexpectedly. Empty and single-step pipelines need documented behavior. Existing converters and generated __init__ performance must remain unchanged when composition is unused. Add tests for order, metadata, self/field-aware converters, nesting, exceptions, defaults, aliases, slots, frozen classes, typing, and backwards compatibility, plus concise API documentation.

让流式重试归并为一条逻辑调用痕迹.display_title: Unify streaming retries into one logical trace
让流式重试归并为一条逻辑调用痕迹.display_description: Represent all attempts of a retried LangChain stream under one logical run while retaining per-attempt diagnostics.
