让流式重试归并为一条逻辑调用痕迹.instruction_en: Change LangChain streaming retry tracing so callers see one logical model invocation containing ordered attempt records rather than unrelated top-level runs. Preserve a stable logical run ID and parent relationship while giving each attempt its own ID, timing, provider metadata, partial chunks, and terminal outcome. Tokens and usage must not be double-counted when a failed attempt is retried, and the logical run must emit exactly one final success or error event. Sync and async streams, cancellation, callback errors, nested chains, and providers that fail before or after yielding chunks must close all attempt spans. Keep externally visible successful stream contents and non-retried tracing compatible. Add deterministic fake-model tests for multiple attempts, partial output, final failure, cancellation, callbacks, usage accounting, and serialized event ordering, and document the event relationship.
让流式重试归并为一条逻辑调用痕迹.smoke: cd libs/core && python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -n 5

修正环境变量列表解析.display_title: Fix Click list parsing from environment variables
修正环境变量列表解析.display_description: Parse environment-provided multiple values consistently with option arity, composite types, paths, and explicit separators.
修正环境变量列表解析.instruction_en: Fix Click environment-variable parsing for multiple and composite option values. Values must split according to the parameter type’s envvar_list_splitter and then group according to nargs and multiple, preserving order and producing the same converted value shape as equivalent command-line arguments. Empty, whitespace-only, quoted-looking, path, tuple, Choice, and custom ParamType inputs must follow documented platform-independent rules without inventing shell parsing. Explicit command-line values retain precedence and default, flag, count, prompt, and single-value options must not regress. Invalid group lengths or conversions must produce normal BadParameter diagnostics naming the environment source without exposing secret values. Add tests for nargs, multiple, composite types, separators, Unicode, empty input, defaults, precedence, custom types, and compatibility, and update environment-variable documentation.

为 Locust 增加可追踪的分阶段统计重置.display_description: Reset Locust statistics at named load-test phase boundaries while retaining an auditable aggregate history.
为 Locust 增加可追踪的分阶段统计重置.instruction_en: Add an opt-in way to reset Locust request statistics at named test-phase boundaries. Each reset must atomically close the current phase, capture an immutable snapshot with name, times, counts, failures, percentiles, and worker participation, then start fresh live statistics without losing in-flight request events. Distributed workers must coordinate a single logical boundary despite delayed or duplicate messages, and late events need a deterministic phase assignment. Web UI, CSV, console, event hooks, and programmatic APIs should expose current-phase and cumulative views without changing defaults. Resetting must not alter users, request scheduling, or error identities. Add fake-clock and distributed-message tests for races, empty phases, duplicate reset commands, workers joining or leaving, serialization, and aggregate reconciliation, plus operational documentation.

为 Task 增加可验证的任务执行收据与离线漂移比较.display_description: Record deterministic, privacy-aware execution receipts and compare them offline to detect task drift.
为 Task 增加可验证的任务执行收据与离线漂移比较.instruction_en: Add optional execution receipts to Task. A receipt should capture a schema version, task identity, normalized effective commands, declared inputs, relevant environment names with protected values, dependency receipt digests, start and end status, and deterministic hashes of configured input and output artifacts. Write the receipt atomically only after the run reaches a terminal state and make retries or concurrent invocations unable to corrupt it. Provide an offline comparison command and reusable API that classifies command, input, dependency, environment, output, and status drift without executing tasks or requiring network access. Stable equivalent runs must compare equal across path separators where appropriate; secrets and file contents must not be embedded. Existing execution, caching, and output are unchanged when disabled. Add tests for reproducibility, tampering, failures, concurrency, redaction, path normalization, schema evolution, and compare exit codes, plus documentation.

为 Viper 增加保留 last-good 状态的事务式热重载.display_description: Validate and atomically publish complete config snapshots while retaining the last good state after reload failures.
为 Viper 增加保留 last-good 状态的事务式热重载.instruction_en: Add an opt-in transactional Viper reload path. On a file event, read and parse a complete candidate, rebuild it with the normal defaults, merges, environment, flags, aliases, and overrides, run registered validation, and publish one immutable effective snapshot only if every step succeeds. Parse errors, partial writes, validation failures, and callback errors must leave the previous last-good state visible and report a structured failure; a later valid change must recover. Concurrent getters may observe either complete snapshot, never mixed generations. Coalesce duplicate watcher events without skipping the final content, order callbacks after commit, and provide generation and failure diagnostics. Existing WatchConfig behavior must remain compatible unless enabled. Add fake-event and concurrency tests for rapid writes, deletions, invalid files, merge precedence, recovery, callback order, races, and shutdown, plus documentation.

为 go-git Blame 增加与 Git 对齐的 ignore-revisi.display_title: Add ignore-revisions semantics to go-git blame
为 go-git Blame 增加与 Git 对齐的 ignore-revisi.display_description: Let go-git blame ignore formatting or bulk-change commits with attribution behavior aligned to Git.
为 go-git Blame 增加与 Git 对齐的 ignore-revisi.instruction_en: Extend go-git blame with an opt-in set or file of revisions to ignore. Lines introduced only by an ignored commit should be attributed through that commit to the nearest meaningful parent when unambiguous; ambiguous or unblamable lines must be marked through a documented result flag consistent with Git’s ignore-revs behavior. Handle multiple ignored revisions, merges, renames, file creation and deletion, whitespace-only mass edits, abbreviated input resolution, and invalid or missing revisions deterministically. Existing Blame API results must remain unchanged without the option, while new result metadata must not break callers. Avoid shelling out to Git. Add repository fixtures comparing expected attribution across linear and merge histories, ignore files with comments, errors, renames, and boundary commits, plus public API and complexity documentation.

转换配置档案的并发隔离与版本快照.display_description: Version conversion profiles and isolate in-flight Docling API requests from concurrent profile changes.
转换配置档案的并发隔离与版本快照.instruction_en: Add named, versioned conversion profiles to docling-api and bind each conversion request to an immutable profile snapshot at acceptance time. Profile create, update, validate, list, and deactivate operations must be permission-checked and use optimistic concurrency so concurrent updates cannot overwrite each other. An in-flight conversion must keep its original effective options even if the named profile changes or is deleted, while a later request receives the new version. Store normalized profile data without secrets, expose the applied name, version, and digest in job status, and preserve existing inline/default configuration behavior. Add tests with controlled workers for concurrent updates, request/update races, invalid options, deactivation, retries, serialization, process restart, tenant isolation, and snapshot immutability, plus API documentation and migration notes.

流式上传入口的边界校验与资源安全.display_description: Validate Docling uploads incrementally and guarantee temporary-resource cleanup across disconnects, limits, and malformed streams.
流式上传入口的边界校验与资源安全.instruction_en: Harden docling-api’s streaming upload endpoint. Enforce declared and actual byte limits incrementally, bound multipart metadata, validate filenames and supported content without trusting Content-Length or extensions, and stop reading as soon as a limit or format violation is known. Write into isolated temporary resources with safe names and permissions, never expose host paths, and atomically hand off only a fully accepted upload. Client disconnects, cancellation, parser errors, worker rejection, timeouts, and concurrent duplicate requests must close handles and remove partial data. Apply authentication and tenant isolation before accepting expensive content, provide stable error responses, and avoid loading the whole file into memory. Preserve valid existing uploads. Add ASGI-level tests using chunked malformed bodies, missing or misleading lengths, disconnects, path names, duplicate finalization, concurrent uploads, and cleanup assertions, plus limit documentation.

异步批处理的条目状态与故障恢复.display_description: Track every item in a Docling batch durably and resume unfinished work safely after worker or service failures.
异步批处理的条目状态与故障恢复.instruction_en: Add durable asynchronous batch jobs to docling-api with explicit per-item queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, and blocked states plus aggregate progress. Submission and each item need idempotency identities so retries cannot duplicate conversion or output. Workers must claim items with leases, renew ownership, and safely recover expired work after a crash; completed items and notifications must not repeat. A configurable concurrency limit and cancellation must stop new claims while allowing or terminating active work according to documented semantics. One item failure must not erase successful results, and retry policy must distinguish transient from permanent errors. Persist enough normalized input and profile version to resume after restart without leaking tenant data. Add fake-worker/clock tests for crashes, lease races, retries, cancellation, mixed outcomes, restart, progress consistency, authorization, and cleanup, plus API documentation.

修复帮助文本宽度计算.display_title: Fix Click help text width calculation
修复帮助文本宽度计算.display_description: Calculate help layout from visible terminal width without miswrapping ANSI, Unicode, indentation, or nested command output.
修复帮助文本宽度计算.instruction_en: Fix Click help formatting so available width and wrapping use visible terminal columns rather than raw string length. Account for indentation, option columns, ANSI styling, wide and combining Unicode characters, explicit max_content_width, COLUMNS, terminal detection, and nested contexts without double-subtracting margins. Long unbreakable tokens and narrow terminals must terminate and produce stable output. Stripping color from the same help text should preserve line-break decisions where styling has zero width. Defaults and established output for plain ASCII at normal widths must remain compatible. Add deterministic CliRunner tests for narrow and wide terminals, colors, CJK and combining text, long option metavars, nested groups, environment width, explicit width, and no-TTY behavior, and document any clarified width semantics.

让上传限制在服务端不可绕过.display_title: Enforce NiceGUI upload limits on the server
让上传限制在服务端不可绕过.display_description: Apply authoritative streaming upload limits independent of browser metadata or client-side validation.
让上传限制在服务端不可绕过.instruction_en: Make NiceGUI upload limits authoritative on the server. Enforce per-file, request-total, file-count, filename, and accepted-type constraints while streaming, without trusting browser-provided size, MIME type, or client validation. Stop reading on violation, return a stable user-visible error, never invoke the normal upload handler, and clean every temporary file and open handle on rejection, disconnect, cancellation, and exceptions. Isolate limits per upload component and user session, prevent concurrent requests from bypassing aggregate bounds, and avoid buffering whole files. Existing applications without configured limits must retain current behavior. Add deterministic ASGI tests for chunked bodies, misleading metadata, multiple files, exact boundaries, empty files, concurrent uploads, disconnects, cleanup, handler suppression, and normal success, and document server versus client validation.

为异步刷新提供 latest-wins 一致性模式.display_description: Prevent stale NiceGUI refresh results from overwriting newer UI state when asynchronous updates complete out of order.
为异步刷新提供 latest-wins 一致性模式.instruction_en: Add an opt-in latest-wins mode for NiceGUI refreshable async functions. Each invocation must receive a monotonically ordered generation within the component or scoped refresh target; only the newest still-relevant generation may commit UI mutations or exposed result state. Earlier work should be cancelled when safe, but code that ignores cancellation must still be prevented from publishing stale output. Exceptions and cancellation from stale generations must not replace a newer success or produce noisy user errors, while the latest failure remains observable. Component deletion, client disconnect, reconnect, nested refreshables, and simultaneous clients must clean state and remain isolated. Preserve current behavior by default. Add controlled-coroutine tests for out-of-order completion, cancellation races, latest failure, nested scopes, disconnects, multi-client isolation, and no leaked tasks, plus documentation.

为持久化存储增加键级过期时间.display_title: Add per-key expiration to persistent storage
为持久化存储增加键级过期时间.display_description: Support durable key-level TTLs in NiceGUI storage with atomic expiry, refresh, deletion, and multi-worker semantics.
为持久化存储增加键级过期时间.instruction_en: Add optional per-key expiration to NiceGUI persistent storage. Public APIs must set, inspect, refresh, and remove TTLs using an injectable monotonic or wall-clock strategy appropriate to persisted deadlines. Expired keys must behave as absent across get, contains, iteration, length, serialization, and update operations and be removed without races. Setting a value, deleting it, clearing storage, and changing a TTL must be atomic with persistence; process restart and multiple workers must not resurrect expired data or delete a newer value. Define behavior for zero, negative, None, missing keys, and clock changes, and preserve all current keys without TTL. Cleanup should be bounded and not require scanning on every read. Add fake-clock tests for boundaries, refresh, overwrite, restart, concurrent readers/writers, iteration, cleanup, and backward-compatible storage migration, plus documentation.

让 GoReleaser 取消构建时清理外部子进程.display_title: Terminate GoReleaser child processes on cancellation
让 GoReleaser 取消构建时清理外部子进程.display_description: Ensure cancellation stops external build commands and their descendants without leaving processes or partial state behind.
让 GoReleaser 取消构建时清理外部子进程.instruction_en: Fix GoReleaser command execution so context cancellation, pipeline failure, and interrupt signals terminate every external child and descendant started for the affected build. Use platform-appropriate process groups or equivalent lifecycle control, first requesting graceful termination and then enforcing a bounded kill, while always waiting to reap processes. Preserve stdout and stderr capture, the original command error when no cancellation occurred, and useful cancellation diagnostics. Parallel unaffected work should follow existing pipeline cancellation policy. Cleanup must not signal unrelated reused process IDs or leave goroutines, descriptors, temporary files, or zombie processes. Keep successful execution unchanged on supported platforms. Add helper-process tests for grandchildren, ignored termination, fast exit races, parallel commands, output capture, timeout escalation, and repeated cancellation, including platform-specific coverage and documentation of guarantees.

聚合游标必须能从同一分片接着读.display_title: Resume aggregate cursors on the same shard
聚合游标必须能从同一分片接着读.display_description: Encode shard identity with cursor progress so go-redis aggregate scans resume without skipping or repeating data.
聚合游标必须能从同一分片接着读.instruction_en: Fix go-redis aggregate or cluster cursor iteration so a returned cursor carries enough shard identity and per-shard progress to resume on the same node deterministically. Paging must visit each eligible shard in stable order, preserve the server cursor for the current shard, and advance only when that shard completes. Duplicate, missing, moved, or temporarily failed shards need documented retry and topology-change behavior without silently skipping keys or restarting every shard. Invalid or stale cursor tokens must return a stable error rather than panic. Single-node clients and existing zero-cursor completion semantics must remain compatible. Add fake-cluster tests for small pages, repeated keys, mid-shard resume, empty shards, retries, topology reorder or removal, malformed tokens, cancellation, and exact command routing, and document cursor opacity and guarantees.
聚合游标必须能从同一分片接着读.smoke: redis-services && REDIS_VERSION=8.10 go test $(go list ./... | grep -v -E '/doctests$|/v9$') -count=1 2>&1 | tail -n 20 && REDIS_VERSION=8.10 go test . -count=1 -timeout 40m -skip 'TestTLS|TestSearchCommandsRESP2AndRESP3Equivalence' -args -ginkgo.skip='JSON|RediSearch|FT\.|Search|RedisTimeseries|TS\.|Probabilistic|bloom|cuckoo|TDigest|TopK|CMS|TLS|tls|Vector|vector|Hybrid|hybrid|Modules|module|DIALECT' 2>&1 | tail -n 25
聚合游标必须能从同一分片接着读._note: root suite needs the compose stack; the image builds Redis 8.10.1 core from its tag and runs standalone/ring/sentinel/cluster locally (ENTRYPOINT); module/TLS/proxy suites are skipped because only the upstream test image provides them.
聚合游标必须能从同一分片接着读.install_block:
RUN go mod download
# ---- services: the root test suite (main_test.go) expects the servers docker-compose.yml provides: a
# standalone at 6379 (redis-stack slot) and 6380/6381, ring shards 6390-6392, a sentinel set (master 9121,
# replicas 9122/9123, sentinels 26379-26381) and six bare cluster-enabled nodes 16600-16605 that the tests
# MEET and assign slots themselves.  Debian 12 only ships Redis 7.0 and the suite uses 7.2+ commands
# (CLIENT SETINFO, WAITAOF, ZRANK WITHSCORE), so Redis 8.10.1 core is built from its release tag (LTO off: the linker step fails under amd64 emulation) (the
# version upstream CI tests, see .github/workflows/build.yml).  `redis-services` starts the whole set
# (idempotent, each instance from its own config file) and the ENTRYPOINT runs it first.
# Not provided: the Redis 8 modules (JSON/Search/TimeSeries/Probabilistic/Vector), TLS endpoints and the
# RESP proxies of the upstream test image; those suites need `make docker.start` with the compose stack.
RUN curl -fsSL https://github.com/redis/redis/archive/refs/tags/8.10.1.tar.gz -o /tmp/redis.tar.gz \
    && mkdir -p /tmp/redis && tar -xzf /tmp/redis.tar.gz -C /tmp/redis --strip-components=1 \
    && (make -C /tmp/redis -j"$(nproc)" MALLOC=libc ENABLE_LTO= >/tmp/redis-build.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 40 /tmp/redis-build.log; exit 1; }) \
    && make -C /tmp/redis install PREFIX=/usr/local >/dev/null \
    && rm -rf /tmp/redis /tmp/redis.tar.gz /tmp/redis-build.log \
    && redis-server --version
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'set -e' \
        'start() { port=$1; shift; redis-cli -p $port ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0; d=/var/lib/redis-test/$port; mkdir -p $d; printf "port %s\ndir %s\ndaemonize yes\nlogfile %s/log\nsave \"\"\nappendonly no\nenable-debug-command yes\nenable-module-command yes\nprotected-mode no\nbind 127.0.0.1\n" $port $d $d > $d/redis.conf; for line in "$@"; do printf "%s\n" "$line" >> $d/redis.conf; done; redis-server $d/redis.conf; }' \
        'for p in 6379 6380 6381 6390 6391 6392; do start $p; done' \
        'start 9121; start 9122 "replicaof 127.0.0.1 9121"; start 9123 "replicaof 127.0.0.1 9121"' \
        'for p in 16600 16601 16602 16603 16604 16605; do start $p "cluster-enabled yes" "cluster-config-file nodes.conf" "cluster-node-timeout 5000"; done' \
        'for p in 26379 26380 26381; do redis-cli -p $p ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && continue; d=/var/lib/redis-test/$p; mkdir -p $d; printf "port %s\nsentinel monitor go-redis-test 127.0.0.1 9121 2\nsentinel down-after-milliseconds go-redis-test 3000\nsentinel failover-timeout go-redis-test 10000\nsentinel parallel-syncs go-redis-test 1\ndir %s\ndaemonize yes\nlogfile %s/log\n" $p $d $d > $d/sentinel.conf; redis-server $d/sentinel.conf --sentinel; done' \
        'for p in 6379 6380 6381 6390 6391 6392 9121 9122 9123 16600 16601 16602 16603 16604 16605 26379 26380 26381; do for i in $(seq 1 30); do redis-cli -p $p ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done; redis-cli -p $p ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "redis on $p did not start" >&2; exit 1; }; done' \
        > /usr/local/bin/redis-services \
    && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'redis-services' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/redis-entrypoint \
    && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/redis-services /usr/local/bin/redis-entrypoint \
    && redis-services && redis-cli -p 26379 sentinel master go-redis-test >/dev/null && redis-cli -p 16600 cluster info | head -1 \
    && for p in 6379 6380 6381 6390 6391 6392 9122 9123 9121 16600 16601 16602 16603 16604 16605 26379 26380 26381; do redis-cli -p $p shutdown nosave >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/redis-test
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/redis-entrypoint"]
# v1.1 node-id scoring: `go test -json` is converted by the official CTRF reporter.
RUN go install github.com/ctrf-io/go-ctrf-json-reporter/cmd/go-ctrf-json-reporter@v0.1.0
ENV PATH="/root/go/bin:${PATH}"

让 CSS 变量支持前向引用并对循环依赖给出可定位错误.display_description: Support forward CSS variable references and report dependency cycles with precise source locations.
让 CSS 变量支持前向引用并对循环依赖给出可定位错误.instruction_en: Change Textual CSS variable resolution from declaration-order substitution to dependency-based evaluation. Variables may reference values declared later and across the existing applicable scopes; resolve the final value deterministically while preserving current precedence and fallback semantics. Detect direct and indirect cycles before style application and produce an actionable error showing the dependency chain and source location for each participating declaration. Undefined variables, malformed references, overrides, themes, hot reload, and multiple stylesheets must retain or clarify their existing errors without partially applying styles. Cache resolution only when safe and invalidate dependents when a variable changes. Add parser and integration tests for forward chains, diamonds, shadowing, fallbacks, cycles, undefined names, reload recovery, and deterministic diagnostics, while preserving CSS without forward references.

让 RichLog 的有界日志在动态裁剪后保持宽度与滚动一致.display_title: Keep bounded RichLog reflow and scrolling consistent
让 RichLog 的有界日志在动态裁剪后保持宽度与滚动一致.display_description: Maintain correct width, wrapping, and scroll anchors as RichLog evicts old lines under a bounded history.
让 RichLog 的有界日志在动态裁剪后保持宽度与滚动一致.instruction_en: Fix Textual RichLog when a maximum retained history evicts old content while the widget is resized or reflowed. Width measurement, wrapped visual lines, virtual size, scrollbar range, and render cache must be recalculated from the retained entries only. A user following the tail should stay at the tail; a user scrolled upward should keep the same retained logical content anchored where possible rather than jumping. Selection and copy ranges must not point into evicted data. Repeated writes, markup, tabs, wide Unicode, no-wrap mode, very narrow widths, clear, and max-lines changes must remain consistent and race-free. Preserve unbounded RichLog behavior. Add pilot-based and unit tests for eviction during resize, follow-tail versus manual scroll, Unicode reflow, cache invalidation, selection, clear, and bounded memory.

为 DirectoryTree 增加可控符号链接遍历并防止异步加载竞态.display_title: Control DirectoryTree symlinks and loading races
为 DirectoryTree 增加可控符号链接遍历并防止异步加载竞态.display_description: Add explicit symlink traversal policy and prevent stale asynchronous directory loads from corrupting the visible tree.
为 DirectoryTree 增加可控符号链接遍历并防止异步加载竞态.instruction_en: Add configurable symlink handling to Textual DirectoryTree: do not follow, follow files only, or follow directories within a documented boundary. Display link identity distinctly, prevent loops using stable filesystem identity, and preserve path filtering and permission-error behavior. Harden asynchronous loading so collapsing, refreshing, changing the root, deleting a node, or following a link while a scan is pending cannot attach stale children to the wrong generation. Newer loads must win, cancellation must clean tasks, and repeated refresh must not duplicate nodes. Broken links, permission changes, cycles, links escaping the allowed root, and platform limitations need safe deterministic results. Preserve the current default policy. Add temporary-filesystem and controlled-loader tests for loops, races, root replacement, errors, ordering, cancellation, and no leaked tasks, plus documentation.

放开软删后，一对多加载必须和一对一同样看见已删行.display_title: Load soft-deleted rows consistently across relations
放开软删后，一对多加载必须和一对一同样看见已删行.display_description: Make Bun's include-deleted relation option apply uniformly to has-many and has-one or belongs-to loads.
放开软删后，一对多加载必须和一对一同样看见已删行.instruction_en: Fix Bun relation loading so the existing option that includes soft-deleted rows applies consistently to has-many relations as it does to singular relations. Propagate the setting through separate relation queries, nested relations, joins, model table aliases, composite keys, and scan paths without removing unrelated scopes or tenant predicates. Parent rows with only deleted children must receive those children when explicitly requested, while normal queries continue to exclude them. Relation-specific overrides should follow a documented precedence and must not leak into sibling relations or later queries. SQL generation must stay parameterized and deterministic. Add tests across supported dialect test infrastructure for has-many, has-one, belongs-to, many-to-many where applicable, nested and sibling relations, custom soft-delete columns, aliases, and unchanged defaults.

跟着看日志时容器重启后要带着原来的过滤接着跟.display_title: Resume filtered log following after container restart
跟着看日志时容器重启后要带着原来的过滤接着跟.display_description: Reconnect lazydocker log streams after restarts while preserving filters, ordering, and user scroll intent.
跟着看日志时容器重启后要带着原来的过滤接着跟.instruction_en: Make lazydocker log following survive a container restart or replacement. Detect the end of the old stream, resolve the current container instance, and reconnect with the same since/tail, stream selection, timestamps, and text filter settings without duplicating already displayed lines. Preserve chronological order and visually mark the restart boundary. If the user is following the tail, continue following; if scrolled up or paused, do not force a jump. Cancellation, view changes, rapid restart loops, missing containers, daemon disconnects, and filter edits during reconnect must terminate stale streams and avoid goroutine or descriptor leaks. Keep non-follow and ordinary log behavior unchanged. Add fake Docker-client tests for reconnect, duplicate timestamps, filter preservation, rapid restarts, cancellation, scroll state, and failure recovery, plus user documentation.

其中一块存储挂了列目录时其他挂载点还要能列出来.display_title: Return partial directory listings across storages
其中一块存储挂了列目录时其他挂载点还要能列出来.display_description: Keep healthy AList mount entries visible when one backing storage fails, with explicit partial-result diagnostics.
其中一块存储挂了列目录时其他挂载点还要能列出来.instruction_en: Fix AList virtual-directory listing so failure of one mounted storage does not hide entries from healthy mounts. Query applicable mounts using existing ordering and permissions, merge successful results deterministically, and return an explicit partial-result warning that identifies only safe storage metadata and classifies timeout, authorization, unavailable, or malformed responses. A failed mount must not be cached as an empty successful directory or remove previously valid entries. Requests targeting the failed mount directly should retain the normal error. Pagination, sorting, duplicate names, hidden entries, cache invalidation, refresh, and concurrent failures need defined behavior, and user permissions must never leak inaccessible mount names or errors. Add fake-storage tests for one and multiple failures, timeouts, name collisions, caching and recovery, pagination, permissions, and all-failed behavior while preserving single-storage success.

为 Scrapy HTTP Cache 增加 Vary 变体支持.display_title: Add Vary-aware variants to Scrapy HTTP cache
为 Scrapy HTTP Cache 增加 Vary 变体支持.display_description: Store and select HTTP cache variants according to Vary request headers without cross-request contamination.
为 Scrapy HTTP Cache 增加 Vary 变体支持.instruction_en: Make Scrapy’s HTTP cache honor response Vary. Store each representation under a deterministic variant key derived from the response’s normalized Vary field names and the corresponding request header values, and select only an exact compatible variant on lookup. Handle multiple Vary lines, case-insensitive names, whitespace, missing headers, and Vary: * according to HTTP semantics. A later variant must not overwrite another, and legacy entries without variant metadata should keep documented compatibility. Apply equivalent behavior to filesystem and DBM storage backends, redirects and revalidation where supported, without storing secrets in cleartext keys or logs. Add tests for Accept-Encoding, Accept-Language, missing values, star, header case/order, multiple variants, corruption, legacy cache entries, persistence, and default behavior, and document storage implications.

为 Sphinx linkcheck 增加跨构建缓存.display_title: Persist Sphinx linkcheck results across builds
为 Sphinx linkcheck 增加跨构建缓存.display_description: Reuse fresh linkcheck outcomes safely across builds with deterministic invalidation and offline-friendly reporting.
为 Sphinx linkcheck 增加跨构建缓存.instruction_en: Add an optional persistent cache for Sphinx linkcheck. Cache normalized target identity, redirect outcome, status, relevant request configuration, check time, and a schema version, and reuse entries only within configurable success and failure TTLs. Changes to authentication, headers, anchors, allowed redirects, timeout policy, or other result-affecting settings must invalidate safely without persisting secrets. Writes must be atomic and tolerate corruption and concurrent builders; stale or malformed records should cause a normal recheck, not fail the build. Cached results must appear in output with stable status and still obey current reporting and failure rules. Support an explicit refresh or disable path and preserve defaults. Add fake-clock/network tests for hits, expiry, config changes, redirects, failures, anchors, corruption, concurrency, redaction, and legacy absence, plus documentation.

为 SQLAlchemy Engine.dispose 增加连接池平滑排空.display_description: Let Engine.dispose stop new checkouts, wait for active connections, and terminate predictably on timeout.
为 SQLAlchemy Engine.dispose 增加连接池平滑排空.instruction_en: Add an opt-in graceful mode to Engine.dispose and the relevant pool APIs. Once draining begins, reject or route new checkouts according to a documented policy, close idle connections immediately, and wait for checked-out connections to return up to an optional timeout. On successful drain, dispose the old pool exactly once; on timeout, return or raise a stable result and force-close only where the dialect safely supports it. Concurrent checkin, invalidate, detach, dispose, garbage collection, and multiple drain callers must not deadlock or corrupt accounting. Sync and async engines need equivalent semantics and cancellation safety. Existing immediate dispose behavior remains the default. Add deterministic pool tests with barriers and fake clocks for idle and active connections, timeout, races, invalidation, async cancellation, repeated calls, and event ordering, plus lifecycle documentation.

为 pip 增加可恢复下载.display_title: Add resumable package downloads to pip
为 pip 增加可恢复下载.display_description: Resume interrupted artifact downloads safely using HTTP range validation and end-to-end package integrity checks.
为 pip 增加可恢复下载.instruction_en: Add resumable downloads for pip package artifacts. Persist partial data and minimal validator metadata in a safe cache location, then use Range and If-Range only when the URL, expected artifact, ETag or Last-Modified, and known length make continuation safe. Accept 206 only with a valid matching Content-Range; if the server returns 200, changes validators, ignores ranges, compresses unexpectedly, or provides inconsistent lengths, discard or restart rather than concatenate corrupt bytes. Completed artifacts must pass the existing hash and wheel or archive checks before atomic promotion. Retries, cancellation, concurrent installers, cache cleanup, credentials, redirects, and offline behavior must remain secure. Preserve current behavior when resume is disabled or impossible. Add local-server tests for interruption, successful resume, fallback, mismatches, concurrency, hash failure, cleanup, and redacted logs, plus documentation.
为 pip 增加可恢复下载.install_block:
# pip's test suite (nox `test` session) installs the package plus tests/requirements.txt.
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -e . -r tests/requirements.txt \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

修正 OpenAPI 路径参数丢失 Django converter 类型信息.display_title: Preserve Django converter types in OpenAPI parameters
修正 OpenAPI 路径参数丢失 Django converter 类型信息.display_description: Infer DRF OpenAPI path parameter schemas from registered Django URL converters instead of falling back to strings.
修正 OpenAPI 路径参数丢失 Django converter 类型信息.instruction_en: Fix Django REST framework OpenAPI schema generation so path parameters retain the type and constraints implied by Django URL converters. Built-in int, slug, uuid, path, and str converters and registered custom converters should map through a public or documented hook to appropriate OpenAPI schemas, while explicit view or serializer schema information keeps precedence. Resolve converter metadata from nested include patterns and namespaced routes without executing conversion code on sample values. Unknown converters must fall back safely to the current string schema, and duplicate parameter generation must be avoided. Runtime routing remains unchanged. Add schema tests for built-ins, custom mappings, nested includes, explicit overrides, duplicate names, format and pattern constraints, unknown converters, and existing regex routes, and document extension behavior.

建立可验证的配置代际与无停机资源切换机制.display_description: Stage, validate, activate, and roll back FTP server configurations as observable immutable generations.
建立可验证的配置代际与无停机资源切换机制.instruction_en: Add configuration generations to ftpserver. Parse and validate a candidate into an immutable generation, including listeners, TLS, authentication, storage, timeouts, and routing, without changing the running service. Activation must atomically direct new sessions to the new resources while existing sessions either finish on their original generation or follow an explicit safe migration policy. Track generation ID, digest, state, validation results, resource readiness, activation time, and active-session counts without exposing secrets. Failed preparation or activation must leave the last good generation serving and clean staged resources; rollback must be idempotent. Rapid concurrent updates need serialization and deterministic results. Add fake-listener/storage tests for validation, resource warmup, activation races, old-session drain, rollback, restart recovery, failures, and cleanup, plus operator APIs and documentation.

构建分层连接准入与登录防滥用机制.display_title: Add layered connection and login abuse controls
构建分层连接准入与登录防滥用机制.display_description: Protect FTP listeners with global, address, account, and authentication rate limits while preserving legitimate sessions.
构建分层连接准入与登录防滥用机制.instruction_en: Add configurable layered admission controls to ftpserver: global and per-source concurrent connection caps, connection-rate limits, per-account session caps, and failed-login throttling with bounded backoff. Apply limits before expensive work where possible, but count identities only after trustworthy information is available. Successful authentication may reset only the appropriate failure state; attackers must not evade controls through username spraying or exhaust unbounded tracking memory. Define proxy-address trust, IPv4 and IPv6 normalization, anonymous users, NAT fairness, idle-session release, and restart behavior. Responses and structured metrics must be useful without enabling account enumeration or leaking credentials. Defaults must preserve existing behavior. Add fake-clock concurrent tests for every limit, boundary release, backoff, successful login, cancellation, eviction, trusted proxy handling, and no resource leaks, plus security documentation.

实现事务化上传、分层配额与重启恢复.display_title: Add transactional uploads and layered quotas
实现事务化上传、分层配额与重启恢复.display_description: Stage FTP uploads privately, enforce account and storage quotas, and recover or clean transactions after restart.
实现事务化上传、分层配额与重启恢复.instruction_en: Make ftpserver uploads transactional. Write incoming data to an isolated temporary object, enforce per-file, account, directory, and backing-storage quotas against reserved plus committed bytes, and publish the final path atomically only after transfer completion, validation, and fsync or backend-equivalent durability. Failed, cancelled, disconnected, timed-out, or conflicting uploads must never expose partial destination content and must release reservations. Resume must bind to the same authenticated owner and transaction, validate offsets and prior data, and remain idempotent. Persist minimal transaction state so restart can recover committed-but-unpublished work or clean abandoned stages without double-counting quota. Renames and concurrent uploads must not bypass limits. Add fault-injection tests for quota races, overwrite, resume, crash points, cleanup, backend failures, and authorization, plus operational documentation.

构建带完整性清单的多资源原子备份代次.display_description: Capture consistent GDG resource generations with integrity manifests, atomic publication, and restart-safe cleanup.
构建带完整性清单的多资源原子备份代次.instruction_en: Add backup generations that capture all selected GDG resource types into a staged generation and publish it atomically only when every required export is complete. Produce a deterministic manifest with schema version, resource identities, normalized paths, sizes, content digests, tool/version metadata, and generation digest, without secrets. Existing active backups must remain untouched on cancellation, export failure, disk exhaustion, or process crash; restart should detect and clean or resume staged generations according to a documented rule. Concurrent backup attempts must not mix files or race the active pointer. Verification must work offline and report missing, extra, or corrupted artifacts precisely. Preserve current individual export behavior. Add fake-resource and filesystem fault tests for success, mixed failure, atomic switch, tampering, cancellation, restart, concurrency, stable manifests, and retention, plus restore/verification documentation.

为三类资源权限实现可预览的安全协调与失败补偿.display_description: Preview and apply permission changes across three GDG resource classes with drift detection and compensating recovery.
为三类资源权限实现可预览的安全协调与失败补偿.instruction_en: Add a permission reconciliation workflow for the three supported GDG resource classes. Compute a deterministic dry-run plan from desired and observed state, including additions, removals, unchanged grants, inherited or unsupported permissions, prerequisites, and risk warnings. Apply only a plan tied to the same observed-state digest, in dependency-safe order, with idempotency keys and per-operation audit results. On partial remote failure, execute safe compensating actions where possible and persist a resumable recovery state rather than claiming success or blindly removing pre-existing access. Enforce least privilege, tenant boundaries, and secret redaction. Re-running after success must be a no-op; concurrent drift must stop stale destructive changes. Add fake API tests for preview, all resource types, ordering, stale plans, partial failure, compensation failure, retries, inheritance, permissions, and stable output, plus operator documentation.

增加分层配置预检与跨上下文只读环境探测.display_description: Validate effective GDG configuration and run bounded read-only probes across contexts before mutating remote resources.
增加分层配置预检与跨上下文只读环境探测.instruction_en: Add a preflight command and reusable API that resolves GDG’s layered configuration for every selected context, validates schema and references, then performs bounded read-only probes for authentication, service reachability, required resource visibility, and capability compatibility. Results must be deterministic and structured by context and probe, distinguish warning, failure, skip, and success, and support human and machine-readable output with useful exit codes. Never perform a write or include credentials in logs or reports. One context failure must not prevent independent probes, and concurrency needs a configurable limit, cancellation, per-probe timeout, and stable result ordering. Normal commands remain unchanged. Add fake-server tests for precedence, missing values, authentication, timeouts, capability differences, partial contexts, cancellation, redaction, and proof that no mutating request occurs, plus documentation.

为 Hugo 开发服务器增加机器可读构建状态端点.display_description: Provide a machine-readable development-server endpoint for consistent build generation, errors, and readiness state.
为 Hugo 开发服务器增加机器可读构建状态端点.instruction_en: Add an opt-in machine-readable status endpoint to Hugo’s development server. Return a stable versioned JSON snapshot containing current build generation, building or idle state, last start and completion times, success, bounded sanitized diagnostics, changed content summary, and whether the served site matches that generation. Updates must be atomic so concurrent requests never see fields from different builds. Initial startup, rapid file events, queued rebuilds, failed builds that keep the last good site, recovery, shutdown, and multiple languages or sites need defined states. Bind to the existing server and security model, avoid exposing filesystem paths or source contents by default, and do not trigger builds. Keep server behavior unchanged when disabled. Add fake-clock/build tests for transitions, overlapping events, failure recovery, sanitization, concurrency, endpoint options, and deterministic JSON, plus documentation.

任务做到一半改了技能文件，当前轮用旧的、下一轮用新的.display_title: Snapshot agent skills per conversation turn
任务做到一半改了技能文件，当前轮用旧的、下一轮用新的.display_description: Keep one immutable skill version throughout an active turn while letting later turns observe filesystem updates.
任务做到一半改了技能文件，当前轮用旧的、下一轮用新的.instruction_en: Change Hermes Agent skill loading so every conversation turn captures one immutable snapshot of all skill files it uses. Repeated model or tool iterations within that turn must read the same content even if a watcher, user, or another turn modifies the file. A later turn started after the change must receive the new version. Concurrent turns may therefore use different snapshots without sharing mutable caches, partial reads, or invalidation races. Capture identity and content atomically, define behavior for deletion and read errors, and keep unchanged files efficiently reusable. Prompt construction and tool retries must not silently switch versions. Add deterministic tests with barriers for mid-turn edits, two overlapping turns, pre-turn edits, deletion, read failure, repeated iterations, and cache isolation, while preserving existing single-turn behavior and documenting the lifecycle.
任务做到一半改了技能文件，当前轮用旧的、下一轮用新的.install_block:
# hermes-agent's CI installs from uv.lock with Python 3.11 (`uv sync --locked --python 3.11 --extra dev
# --extra messaging`); the gateway tests import aiohttp (messaging extra) and tests/acp import
# agent-client-protocol (acp extra). mars-base's uv 0.9.18 cannot read this lockfile, so a
# current uv is pinned. The venv lives outside /app because the repo does not ignore .venv.
ENV UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir uv==0.12.9 \
    && python -m uv sync --locked --python 3.11 --no-default-groups --extra dev --extra messaging --extra acp \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}"

让 Group 支持可恢复的依赖工作流.display_title: Make Amboy groups durable dependency workflows
让 Group 支持可恢复的依赖工作流.display_description: Schedule Group jobs by dependencies with bounded concurrency, durable progress, cancellation, and branch-local failure handling.
让 Group 支持可恢复的依赖工作流.instruction_en: Extend Amboy Group into a recoverable dependency workflow executor. Validate every dependency reference and detect self-dependencies and cycles before starting work. Schedule ready jobs only after all prerequisites succeed or are explicitly skipped, enforce a positive configurable concurrency bound, and expose race-free immutable progress snapshots with waiting, ready, running, succeeded, failed, and blocked states. A failure must block only its transitive dependents while independent branches continue, preserving original errors and results. On cancellation, stop launching, cancel and wait for active jobs, then serialize enough progress that reparsing and rerunning executes only unfinished eligible work; successful or explicit skipped jobs must not repeat side effects. Preserve registry format compatibility and existing parallel behavior for dependency-free groups. Add race-enabled tests for DAGs, joins, failures, cancellation/reload, invalid graphs, progress copying, serialization, and results.

让 CursorPagination 使用完整复合排序位置稳定翻页.display_title: Use full compound positions in cursor pagination
让 CursorPagination 使用完整复合排序位置稳定翻页.display_description: Make DRF CursorPagination honor every ordering field across forward and reverse pages under concurrent changes.
让 CursorPagination 使用完整复合排序位置稳定翻页.instruction_en: Update CursorPagination to support list or tuple compound ordering as a true lexicographic cursor position. Encode every ordering value and generate forward and reverse boundaries respecting each field’s ascending or descending direction. Continue comparing later fields when earlier values tie, and use the existing offset fallback only when the entire compound position repeats. Next, previous, and direction changes must return adjacent stable pages without repeating already returned objects or omitting original objects after insertions or deletions before the cursor. Support model instances and values dictionaries. Preserve the existing cursor format and behavior for a string or one-element ordering. Reject malformed, incomplete, mismatched, or invalid compound cursor data using existing invalid-cursor semantics. Add tests for mixed directions, ties, mutations, reversal, offsets, null constraints, dictionaries, and compatibility, and update documentation.

为 urllib3 增加可选的 Happy Eyeballs 双栈连接竞速.display_description: Race IPv6 and IPv4 candidates with one timeout budget while preserving urllib3's existing connection behavior by default.
为 urllib3 增加可选的 Happy Eyeballs 双栈连接竞速.instruction_en: Add an optional happy_eyeballs_delay from create_connection through HTTPConnection, HTTPSConnection, both pools, PoolManager, and ProxyManager. None must preserve serial behavior; reject negative, NaN, and infinite delays. When enabled, interleave IPv6 and IPv4 candidates starting with the first DNS family while preserving order within each family. Start the first immediately, stagger later attempts, and advance early after an explicit failure. Return only the first successful socket, close and join every loser on success, failure, timeout, cancellation, or interruption, and use one total connect-timeout budget after DNS rather than resetting it per candidate. Preserve source_address, socket_options, single-family behavior, and existing resolution, timeout, and connection error mapping. Pool keys must distinguish delay settings. Add deterministic fake DNS/socket/clock tests for ordering, races, cleanup, timeouts, errors, propagation, and default compatibility, plus documentation.
为 urllib3 增加可选的 Happy Eyeballs 双栈连接竞速.install_block:
# urllib3's nox sessions run `uv sync --group dev` from uv.lock (test deps such as trustme live in the
# dev dependency group). mars-base's uv 0.9.18 cannot read this lockfile; the repo does not ignore .venv,
# so the environment lives outside /app.
ENV UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "uv==0.12.9" \
    && python -m uv sync --frozen --no-default-groups --group dev --extra socks \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}"

为 Gin 增加可信 RFC 7239 Forwarded 请求元数据解析.display_description: Derive client IP, scheme, and host from one fully validated trusted Forwarded chain with safe fallback.
为 Gin 增加可信 RFC 7239 Forwarded 请求元数据解析.instruction_en: Add opt-in trusted parsing of RFC 7239 Forwarded headers. Only accept data when the direct peer and relevant right-to-left proxy chain satisfy Gin’s trusted-proxy configuration. Parse multiple header lines and elements, case-insensitive parameters, quoted strings and escapes, IPv4 and IPv6 node forms, then derive client IP, external scheme, and host from the same validated element. Never mix fields across elements. Any malformed syntax, duplicate critical parameter, invalid address or authority, unknown or obfuscated for value, unsupported protocol, control character, or broken trust chain must reject the entire standard header and fall back to current RemoteAddr and X-Forwarded behavior. Real TLS always reports https. Keep all behavior unchanged when disabled. Add proxy-matrix, parser, fallback, repeated-read, concurrency, and existing ClientIP/Scheme tests.

为 Gin 增加原子批量路由注册能力.display_description: Validate and commit route plans atomically on Gin engines and groups without exposing partial routing state.
为 Gin 增加原子批量路由注册能力.instruction_en: Add a public route-plan API on Engine and RouterGroup that collects method, relative path, and handler-chain entries before one atomic commit. Planning alone must not affect matching or Routes. Commit must validate all existing method, path, wildcard, handler-count, and conflict rules against both the current tree and earlier batch entries, returning a structured error with batch index, method, full path, conflicting route, and category instead of panicking. If any item fails, the routing tree must remain exactly unchanged; success publishes all routes with normal prefixes, middleware order, params, catch-alls, enumeration, 404, and 405 behavior. Repeated plans and concurrent startup commits need deterministic race-free results. Reject batch commits once request serving has begun, including the first-request race. Preserve existing single-route APIs and their panic behavior. Add route-tree, concurrency, atomicity, middleware, enumeration, and race tests.

带跨行跨列的 HTML 表转成 Markdown 后对齐不能漂.display_description: Convert rowspan and colspan tables to a stable Markdown grid without shifting or losing cell ownership.
带跨行跨列的 HTML 表转成 Markdown 后对齐不能漂.install_block:
# Monorepo: the task lives in packages/markitdown; its `all` extra brings the converter dependencies
# (python-pptx, lxml, pandas, ...) that the test suite imports.
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -e "packages/markitdown[all]" "pytest==9.1.1" \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
带跨行跨列的 HTML 表转成 Markdown 后对齐不能漂.instruction_en: Fix MarkItDown HTML table conversion so rowspan and colspan are expanded into a consistent logical grid before Markdown rendering. Every source cell must retain the columns and rows it covers; cells to the right or in later rows must not shift into occupied positions. Define a deterministic representation for repeated or placeholder content from spanning cells that keeps the table readable and rectangular without losing original text. Handle combined row and column spans, header cells, omitted sections, malformed or overlapping span values, nested inline content, and rows of different apparent widths safely. Tables without spans must keep their current output. Add tests through the public HTML conversion entry point for colspan, rowspan, combined spans, headers, malformed spans, content preservation, exact column counts, and existing normal tables.
带跨行跨列的 HTML 表转成 Markdown 后对齐不能漂.smoke: cd packages/markitdown && python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -n 5

为 Starlette StaticFiles 增加预压缩静态资源协商.display_description: Optionally negotiate Brotli and gzip sidecars in StaticFiles with representation-correct caching, ranges, and HEAD responses.
为 Starlette StaticFiles 增加预压缩静态资源协商.instruction_en: Add an explicit StaticFiles option for serving precompressed .br and .gz sidecars. Negotiate br, gzip, identity, wildcards, q values, and q=0 correctly, considering a sidecar only when the original resource also exists. Keep the original URL and media type while setting Content-Encoding and Vary: Accept-Encoding. Content-Length, ETag, Last-Modified, conditional evaluation, HEAD behavior, and single-range 206 or 416 responses must all use the selected representation; validators from different encodings must never match each other. Missing sidecars, explicit identity, directory redirects, HTML index and 404 pages, package resources, and disabled mode must preserve existing behavior. Reuse current asynchronous file and path-safety checks, add no runtime compressor, and add ASGI tests for negotiation, conditions, ranges, traversal, fallbacks, headers, and regressions, plus documentation.

bze5200727ac9f10be0e7620477a7a38.install_block:
# transmute's backend imports python-magic and cairosvg at module import time (backend/core, conftest);
# upstream docker/Dockerfile installs these runtime libraries; libgl1 lets pyrender import (pytest 9 treats
# its ImportError as a collection error rather than a skip). Heavy converters (ffmpeg, ghostscript,
# inkscape, tesseract, libreoffice, calibre) are left out: CI skips the end-to-end conversion tests.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libmagic1=1:5.44-3 libsm6=2:1.2.3-1 libxext6=2:1.3.4-1+b1 libopengl0=1.6.0-1 libgl1=1.6.0-1 libosmesa6=22.3.6-1+deb12u2 \
       libpango-1.0-0=1.50.12+ds-1 libpangocairo-1.0-0=1.50.12+ds-1 libgdk-pixbuf-2.0-0=2.42.10+dfsg-1+deb12u4 libcairo2=1.16.0-7 librsvg2-bin=2.54.7+dfsg-1~deb12u1 libffi-dev=3.4.4-1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
    -r requirements.txt \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir "pytest==9.1.1" \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

bzeec9e5dc381e5f89aa84818a3f4907.display_description: Construct and validate the whole OTEL_CONFIG_FILE configuration before any global state is set, releasing resources exactly once on failure so a corrected retry works.
bzeec9e5dc381e5f89aa84818a3f4907.install_block:
# uv workspace: the repo root is not an installable package, so the workspace members are installed
# editable from uv.lock (`--all-packages`), plus the repo's own pinned dev-requirements.txt (pytest etc.),
# which is what tox-uv uses in upstream CI. mars-base's uv 0.9.18 cannot read this lockfile.
ENV UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "uv==0.12.9" \
    && python -m uv sync --frozen --all-packages --no-default-groups \
    && python -m uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python -r dev-requirements.txt \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}"
bzeec9e5dc381e5f89aa84818a3f4907.smoke: cd opentelemetry-configuration && python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -n 4 && cd ../opentelemetry-sdk && python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -n 3

bz3598324c55fd4f813b888550980807.source_title: Webhook HMAC 密钥无中断轮换
bz3598324c55fd4f813b888550980807._note: Tests need PostgreSQL + Redis (configuration_testing.py); both are installed in the image, started by the ENTRYPOINT (netbox-services), role/db created and migrated at build; smoke runs DB-backed API and event-rule tests offline.
bz3598324c55fd4f813b888550980807.install_block:
# ---- services: netbox's test suite (configuration_testing.py) needs PostgreSQL and Redis on localhost.
# Both run inside the image so the suite works in an offline container; Debian 12 versions resolved in
# mars-base on 2026-09-12. psycopg[c] (requirements.txt) builds against libpq.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        libpq-dev=15.19-0+deb12u1 postgresql-15=15.19-0+deb12u1 postgresql-client-15=15.19-0+deb12u1 \
        redis-server=5:7.0.15-1~deb12u9 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir "pytest==9.1.1" \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
# `netbox-services` starts PostgreSQL 15 and Redis 7 (idempotent, ~2 s) and waits until both answer.
# The image's ENTRYPOINT runs it before every command, so `docker run <image> <cmd>` and the test
# runner below always find the services up; call it again by hand if they were stopped.
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'set -e' \
        'pg_ctlcluster 15 main status >/dev/null 2>&1 || pg_ctlcluster 15 main start' \
        'redis-cli ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || redis-server --daemonize yes --save "" --appendonly no --logfile /var/log/redis-server.log >/dev/null' \
        'for i in $(seq 1 30); do pg_isready -q -h localhost && redis-cli ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done' \
        'echo "postgresql/redis did not come up" >&2; exit 1' \
        > /usr/local/bin/netbox-services \
    && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'netbox-services' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/netbox-entrypoint \
    && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/netbox-services /usr/local/bin/netbox-entrypoint
# Database role/database from configuration_testing.py (netbox/netbox, CREATEDB so Django can create the
# test database); the schema is migrated once here to prove the stack works, then services are stopped.
ENV NETBOX_CONFIGURATION=netbox.configuration_testing
RUN netbox-services \
    && su postgres -c "psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c \"CREATE ROLE netbox WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'netbox' CREATEDB;\"" \
    && su postgres -c "createdb -O netbox netbox" \
    && python netbox/manage.py migrate --no-input \
    && python netbox/manage.py check \
    && redis-cli shutdown nosave \
    && pg_ctlcluster 15 main stop
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/netbox-entrypoint"]
bz3598324c55fd4f813b888550980807.smoke: netbox-services && python netbox/manage.py test netbox.tests.test_api extras.tests.test_event_rules --parallel 1 -v 1 2>&1 | tail -n 6

bzbbb26c4fe1e4fd9f2b1b3ae4839956.source_title: 工作流 Webhook 可验证签名与重试身份
bzbbb26c4fe1e4fd9f2b1b3ae4839956._note: uv.lock pins torch==2.13.0+cpu from the pytorch-cpu index, which pip cannot resolve from PyPI; in-image uv sync (as upstream CI) plus the CI apt packages. Entrypoint pins paperless-ngx.com in /etc/hosts so the mocked webhook test runs offline; smoke runs the workflow tests.
bzbbb26c4fe1e4fd9f2b1b3ae4839956.install_block:
# Upstream CI (ci-backend.yml): apt unpaper/tesseract/imagemagick/ghostscript/poppler, then
# `uv sync --frozen --group testing`. The lockfile pins torch to the pytorch-cpu index (+cpu builds
# that PyPI does not carry), so the environment is created by uv from uv.lock rather than pip.
# Debian 12 versions resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-09; libmagic1 backs python-magic.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        unpaper=7.0.0-0.1 tesseract-ocr=5.3.0-2 imagemagick=8:6.9.11.60+dfsg-1.6+deb12u13 \
        ghostscript=10.0.0~dfsg-11+deb12u8 poppler-utils=22.12.0-2+deb12u3 libmagic1=1:5.44-3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ENV UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "uv==0.12.9" \
    && python -m uv sync --frozen --no-default-groups --group testing --python /usr/local/bin/python3.12 \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}"
# documents/tests/test_workflows.py::TestWebhookSend mocks httpx but PinnedHostHTTPTransport still resolves the
# hostname; offline that raises. The entrypoint maps paperless-ngx.com to a public (TEST-NET-3, RFC 5737) address
# in /etc/hosts at container start (the file is generated per container, so it cannot be baked into the image).
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'grep -q "paperless-ngx.com" /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null || echo "203.0.113.10 paperless-ngx.com" >> /etc/hosts' \
        'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/paperless-entrypoint && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/paperless-entrypoint
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/paperless-entrypoint"]

# poetry.lock was written by Poetry 2.4.3 (mars-base ships 1.8.2). The project is Poetry itself, so it
# cannot be installed into the interpreter that runs Poetry ("Cannot install poetry-core"): as in
# upstream CI the dependencies go into Poetry's own virtualenv, which is then put on PATH.
ENV POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_IN_PROJECT=false POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_PATH=/opt/venvs
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "poetry==2.4.3" \
    && mkdir -p /opt/venvs && poetry config virtualenvs.create true \
    && poetry env use /usr/local/bin/python3.12 \
    && (poetry check --lock || poetry lock) \
    && poetry install --no-interaction --no-ansi --with dev,test \
    && ln -s "$(poetry env info -p)" /opt/venv \
    && git checkout -- poetry.lock \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}"

RUN sed -i "s/^port = 5432/port = 5423/" /etc/postgresql/15/main/postgresql.conf \
    && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'pg_ctlcluster 15 main status >/dev/null 2>&1 || pg_ctlcluster 15 main start' \
        'for i in $(seq 1 30); do pg_isready -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5423 && exit 0; sleep 1; done' \
        'echo "postgresql did not come up" >&2; exit 1' > /usr/local/bin/pg-services \
    && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        '# docker shim: the test suite only uses `docker compose ... up -d postgres` / `down`; map them to the local cluster' \
        'case " $* " in *" up "*) exec pg-services ;; *" down "*|*" stop "*|*" rm "*) exit 0 ;; esac' \

    && mkdir -p /opt/venvs && poetry config virtualenvs.create true \

    && poetry install --no-interaction --no-ansi --with dev,test \
    && ln -s "$(poetry env info -p)" /opt/venv \
    && git checkout -- poetry.lock \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

bz04ccb92ee3190553bfc0e2558dbad9.source_title: 为 grpc-gateway 增加请求绑定来源追踪
bz04ccb92ee3190553bfc0e2558dbad9._note: QC: environment lacked buf/swagger/oapi-codegen; the Makefile's pinned generators plus local protoc plugins and a local buf template are baked in, buf cache warmed for offline use.
bz04ccb92ee3190553bfc0e2558dbad9.install_block:
RUN go mod download
# ---- code generation toolchain: the task's acceptance criteria regenerate gateway handlers, so the tools the
# repo's Makefile installs are baked in at the versions it pins (`make install`: buf v1.45.0, oapi-codegen
# v2.6.0, go-swagger v0.33.2) together with the protoc plugins buf.gen.yaml runs as *remote* plugins
# (protocolbuffers/go v1.35.1, grpc/go v1.5.1) and this repo's own plugins.  Offline containers cannot use
# remote plugins, so /opt/buf.gen.local.yaml is the same template with local plugins:
#     buf generate --template /opt/buf.gen.local.yaml      (== `make proto` step 1, offline)
# The googleapis dependency from buf.lock is fetched into the buf cache here so it is available offline.
RUN go install github.com/bufbuild/buf/cmd/buf@v1.45.0 \
    && go install github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen@v2.6.0 \
    && go install github.com/go-swagger/go-swagger/cmd/swagger@v0.33.2 \
    && go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go@v1.35.1 \
    && go install google.golang.org/grpc/cmd/protoc-gen-go-grpc@v1.5.1 \
    && go install ./protoc-gen-grpc-gateway ./protoc-gen-openapiv2 ./protoc-gen-openapiv3
ENV PATH="/root/go/bin:${PATH}"
RUN sed -e 's#remote: buf.build/protocolbuffers/go:v1.35.1#local: protoc-gen-go#' \
        -e 's#remote: buf.build/grpc/go:v1.5.1#local: protoc-gen-go-grpc#' buf.gen.yaml > /opt/buf.gen.local.yaml \
    && buf generate --template /opt/buf.gen.local.yaml \
    && git checkout -- . && git clean -fdq
# v1.1 node-id scoring: `go test -json` is converted by the official CTRF reporter.
RUN go install github.com/ctrf-io/go-ctrf-json-reporter/cmd/go-ctrf-json-reporter@v0.1.0

bzda0b41223f06bc3a667f00d204a269._note: root suite needs the compose stack; the image builds Redis 8.10.1 core from its tag and runs standalone/ring/sentinel/cluster locally (ENTRYPOINT); module/TLS/proxy suites are skipped because only the upstream test image provides them.
bzda0b41223f06bc3a667f00d204a269.install_block:
RUN go mod download
# ---- services: the root test suite (main_test.go) expects the servers docker-compose.yml provides: a
# standalone at 6379 (redis-stack slot) and 6380/6381, ring shards 6390-6392, a sentinel set (master 9121,
# replicas 9122/9123, sentinels 26379-26381) and six bare cluster-enabled nodes 16600-16605 that the tests
# MEET and assign slots themselves.  Debian 12 only ships Redis 7.0 and the suite uses 7.2+ commands
# (CLIENT SETINFO, WAITAOF, ZRANK WITHSCORE), so Redis 8.10.1 core is built from its release tag (LTO off: the linker step fails under amd64 emulation) (the
# version upstream CI tests, see .github/workflows/build.yml).  `redis-services` starts the whole set
# (idempotent, each instance from its own config file) and the ENTRYPOINT runs it first.
# Not provided: the Redis 8 modules (JSON/Search/TimeSeries/Probabilistic/Vector), TLS endpoints and the
# RESP proxies of the upstream test image; those suites need `make docker.start` with the compose stack.
RUN curl -fsSL https://github.com/redis/redis/archive/refs/tags/8.10.1.tar.gz -o /tmp/redis.tar.gz \
    && mkdir -p /tmp/redis && tar -xzf /tmp/redis.tar.gz -C /tmp/redis --strip-components=1 \
    && (make -C /tmp/redis -j"$(nproc)" MALLOC=libc ENABLE_LTO= >/tmp/redis-build.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 40 /tmp/redis-build.log; exit 1; }) \
    && make -C /tmp/redis install PREFIX=/usr/local >/dev/null \
    && rm -rf /tmp/redis /tmp/redis.tar.gz /tmp/redis-build.log \
    && redis-server --version
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'set -e' \
        'start() { port=$1; shift; redis-cli -p $port ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0; d=/var/lib/redis-test/$port; mkdir -p $d; printf "port %s\ndir %s\ndaemonize yes\nlogfile %s/log\nsave \"\"\nappendonly no\nenable-debug-command yes\nenable-module-command yes\nprotected-mode no\nbind 127.0.0.1\n" $port $d $d > $d/redis.conf; for line in "$@"; do printf "%s\n" "$line" >> $d/redis.conf; done; redis-server $d/redis.conf; }' \
        'for p in 6379 6380 6381 6390 6391 6392; do start $p; done' \
        'start 9121; start 9122 "replicaof 127.0.0.1 9121"; start 9123 "replicaof 127.0.0.1 9121"' \
        'for p in 16600 16601 16602 16603 16604 16605; do start $p "cluster-enabled yes" "cluster-config-file nodes.conf" "cluster-node-timeout 5000"; done' \
        'for p in 26379 26380 26381; do redis-cli -p $p ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && continue; d=/var/lib/redis-test/$p; mkdir -p $d; printf "port %s\nsentinel monitor go-redis-test 127.0.0.1 9121 2\nsentinel down-after-milliseconds go-redis-test 3000\nsentinel failover-timeout go-redis-test 10000\nsentinel parallel-syncs go-redis-test 1\ndir %s\ndaemonize yes\nlogfile %s/log\n" $p $d $d > $d/sentinel.conf; redis-server $d/sentinel.conf --sentinel; done' \
        'for p in 6379 6380 6381 6390 6391 6392 9121 9122 9123 16600 16601 16602 16603 16604 16605 26379 26380 26381; do for i in $(seq 1 30); do redis-cli -p $p ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done; redis-cli -p $p ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "redis on $p did not start" >&2; exit 1; }; done' \
        > /usr/local/bin/redis-services \
    && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'redis-services' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/redis-entrypoint \
    && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/redis-services /usr/local/bin/redis-entrypoint \
    && redis-services && redis-cli -p 26379 sentinel master go-redis-test >/dev/null && redis-cli -p 16600 cluster info | head -1 \
    && for p in 6379 6380 6381 6390 6391 6392 9122 9123 9121 16600 16601 16602 16603 16604 16605 26379 26380 26381; do redis-cli -p $p shutdown nosave >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/redis-test
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/redis-entrypoint"]
# v1.1 node-id scoring: `go test -json` is converted by the official CTRF reporter.
RUN go install github.com/ctrf-io/go-ctrf-json-reporter/cmd/go-ctrf-json-reporter@v0.1.0
ENV PATH="/root/go/bin:${PATH}"
bzda0b41223f06bc3a667f00d204a269.smoke: redis-services && REDIS_VERSION=8.10 go test $(go list ./... | grep -v -E '/doctests$|/v9$') -count=1 2>&1 | tail -n 20 && REDIS_VERSION=8.10 go test . -count=1 -timeout 40m -skip 'TestTLS|TestSearchCommandsRESP2AndRESP3Equivalence' -args -ginkgo.skip='JSON|RediSearch|FT\.|Search|RedisTimeseries|TS\.|Probabilistic|bloom|cuckoo|TDigest|TopK|CMS|TLS|tls|Vector|vector|Hybrid|hybrid|Modules|module|DIALECT' 2>&1 | tail -n 25

bzb780e90c34c730356f11df4caf88e4._note: pyproject has [tool.uv] exclude-newer, so gen must run with UV_INDEX_URL unset (the tuna mirror lacks upload times); tests need the dev group too (pydantic, duckdb); CI's frontend stub (marimo/_static/index.html, favicon.ico) and UV env are baked in. ENV LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8

    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        libpq-dev=15.19-0+deb12u1 postgresql-15=15.19-0+deb12u1 postgresql-client-15=15.19-0+deb12u1 \

    && tar -xzf /tmp/solr.tgz -C /opt && mv /opt/solr-9.9.0 /opt/solr \

# `ckan-services` starts PostgreSQL 15, Redis 7 and Solr 9 (idempotent) and waits until all answer.
# The image's ENTRYPOINT runs it before every command, so `docker run <image> <cmd>` and the test
# runner below always find the services up; call it again by hand if they were stopped.
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'set -e' \
        'pg_ctlcluster 15 main status >/dev/null 2>&1 || pg_ctlcluster 15 main start' \
        'redis-cli ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || redis-server --daemonize yes --save "" --appendonly no --logfile /var/log/redis-server.log >/dev/null' \
        'curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8983/solr/admin/cores >/dev/null 2>&1 || /opt/solr/bin/solr start -force -p 8983 -m 512m >/dev/null' \
        'for i in $(seq 1 60); do pg_isready -q -h localhost && redis-cli ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:8983/solr/ckan/admin/ping" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done' \
        'echo "postgresql/redis/solr did not come up" >&2; exit 1' \
        > /usr/local/bin/ckan-services \
    && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'ckan-services' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/ckan-entrypoint \
    && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/ckan-services /usr/local/bin/ckan-entrypoint
# Solr core `ckan` with CKAN's own schema (ckan/config/solr/schema.xml, as doc/maintaining/installing/solr.rst),
# then the databases and roles from test-core.ini, initialised the way test-infrastructure/init_environment.sh
# does it in CI (datastore permissions, tablefunc, `ckan db init`). Services are stopped again afterwards.
RUN /opt/solr/bin/solr start -force -p 8983 -m 512m \
    && /opt/solr/bin/solr create -c ckan \
    && cp ckan/config/solr/schema.xml /opt/solr/server/solr/ckan/conf/managed-schema \
    && /opt/solr/bin/solr restart -force -p 8983 -m 512m \
    && ckan-services \
    && su postgres -c "psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c \"CREATE USER ckan_default WITH PASSWORD 'pass' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE;\"" \
    && su postgres -c "psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c \"CREATE USER datastore_default WITH PASSWORD 'pass' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE;\"" \
    && su postgres -c "createdb --encoding=utf-8 --owner=ckan_default ckan_test" \
    && su postgres -c "createdb --encoding=utf-8 --owner=ckan_default datastore_test" \
    && ckan -c test-core.ini datastore set-permissions | su postgres -c "psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1" \
    && su postgres -c "psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d datastore_test -c 'CREATE EXTENSION tablefunc;'" \
    && ckan -c test-core.ini db init \
    && redis-cli shutdown nosave \
    && /opt/solr/bin/solr stop -all \
    && pg_ctlcluster 15 main stop
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/ckan-entrypoint"]

bzd7a978c8e5bd271a75cdd2d3c2b17d._note: same commit for all five memos tasks; see the comments in the install block.
bzd7a978c8e5bd271a75cdd2d3c2b17d.install_block:
# Two tests in server/router/api/v1 depend on the host environment: TestDetectAttachmentMimeType reads
# the system MIME database (Debian's /etc/mime.types maps .xyz to chemical/x-xyz; with shared-mime-info
# present Go uses /usr/share/mime/globs2 like the Ubuntu CI runners) and
# TestUserWebhookSigningSecretLifecycle resolves example.com and requires a public address.
# Debian 12 version resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-14.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends shared-mime-info=2.2-1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN go mod download
# v1.1 node-id scoring: `go test -json` is converted by the official CTRF reporter.
RUN go install github.com/ctrf-io/go-ctrf-json-reporter/cmd/go-ctrf-json-reporter@v0.1.0
ENV PATH="/root/go/bin:${PATH}"
# Offline containers cannot resolve example.com: the entrypoint pins it to one of its public addresses
# (23.192.228.80, a.k.a. the IANA reserved-domain host) in /etc/hosts, which Docker rewrites per container.
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'grep -q " example.com" /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null || echo "23.192.228.80 example.com" >> /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null || true' \
        'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/memos-entrypoint \
    && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/memos-entrypoint
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/memos-entrypoint"]

bzcc44b2ea5e5fba3a98f0caf61d62f1._note: same commit for the three scons tasks. SCons has its own runner: CI runs `python runtest.py SCons test testing --jobs=0` (1309 tests, ~3 min here; 278 report no result for missing optional tools, as in CI). Three tests are excluded because the container runs as root (they expect writes to unwritable paths / chmod-restricted files to fail): test/Errors/permission-denied.py, test/option/debug-json.py, testing/framework/TestCmdTests.py. Under amd64 emulation two timing-sensitive tests (test/leaky-handles.py, test/ninja/iterative_speedup.py) are excluded as well; they pass natively.
bzcc44b2ea5e5fba3a98f0caf61d62f1.install_block:
# Upstream CI (.github/workflows/runtest.yml) installs libtirpc-dev for the Rpcgen tests; Debian 12 version
# resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-14.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libtirpc-dev=1.3.3+ds-1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# No lockfile upstream: pinned with `uv pip compile` over pyproject.toml, requirements.txt and
# requirements-dev.txt (dependency group dev, as CI's `pip-install: --group dev`), resolved for Linux / CPython 3.12.
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
        "lxml==6.1.3" \
        "ninja==1.13.2" \
        "psutil==7.2.2" \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps -e . \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir "pytest==9.1.1" \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

bzc719d8d008d83f9e66c65e2933c80d.source_title: 按唯一头任务结算原生 chord
bzc719d8d008d83f9e66c65e2933c80d._note: git+ pins from requirements/*.txt are rejected by the client's intake check; install the repo's requirement files directly. pytest from the repo root also collects t/integration and t/smoke (need a broker / docker; hang offline), so the smoke runs t/unit like CI. Run as the unprivileged `ci` user created in the image: root breaks 6 tests in both directions (worker refuses root; privilege-check tests expect root detection). --capture=no avoids the prefork fork deadlock; ulimit -n 65536 keeps the fd-safety test from walking 1M descriptors. Under amd64 emulation the full unit suite exceeds the 1 h budget, so the emulated smoke only collects; the native run is the real check.

smoke.native: ulimit -n 65536; su -p ci -c 'export HOME=/home/ci; cd /app && python -m pytest t/unit -q -p no:cacheprovider --capture=no' 2>&1 | tail -n 40
smoke.emulated: su -p ci -c 'export HOME=/home/ci; cd /app && python -m pytest t/unit --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider' 2>&1 | tail -n 5

bz9a723c464830d97977c2f1579d7bfd.source_title: 文档重处理结果的跨存储代际发布
bz9a723c464830d97977c2f1579d7bfd._note: recipe reused from paperless-ngx-4c97c8 (same base commit / same environment). uv.lock pins torch==2.13.0+cpu from the pytorch-cpu index, which pip cannot resolve from PyPI; in-image uv sync (as upstream CI) plus the CI apt packages. Entrypoint pins paperless-ngx.com in /etc/hosts so the mocked webhook test runs offline; smoke runs the workflow tests.
bz9a723c464830d97977c2f1579d7bfd.install_block:
# Upstream CI (ci-backend.yml): apt unpaper/tesseract/imagemagick/ghostscript/poppler, then
# `uv sync --frozen --group testing`. The lockfile pins torch to the pytorch-cpu index (+cpu builds
# that PyPI does not carry), so the environment is created by uv from uv.lock rather than pip.
# Debian 12 versions resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-09; libmagic1 backs python-magic.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        unpaper=7.0.0-0.1 tesseract-ocr=5.3.0-2 imagemagick=8:6.9.11.60+dfsg-1.6+deb12u13 \
        ghostscript=10.0.0~dfsg-11+deb12u8 poppler-utils=22.12.0-2+deb12u3 libmagic1=1:5.44-3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ENV UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "uv==0.12.9" \
    && python -m uv sync --frozen --no-default-groups --group testing --python /usr/local/bin/python3.12 \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}"
# documents/tests/test_workflows.py::TestWebhookSend mocks httpx but PinnedHostHTTPTransport still resolves the
# hostname; offline that raises. The entrypoint maps paperless-ngx.com to a public (TEST-NET-3, RFC 5737) address
# in /etc/hosts at container start (the file is generated per container, so it cannot be baked into the image).
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'grep -q "paperless-ngx.com" /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null || echo "203.0.113.10 paperless-ngx.com" >> /etc/hosts' \
        'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/paperless-entrypoint && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/paperless-entrypoint
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/paperless-entrypoint"]
