bz082eb3312d20cf3b7eaa939fe589ba.install_block:
RUN go mod download
# The bls12381 build tag links supranational/blst, whose x86 assembly probes for ADX/BMI2 at start-up and aborts with
# SIGILL on CPUs (or emulators) without them; blst's documented portable build avoids that.
ENV CGO_CFLAGS="-O2 -D__BLST_PORTABLE__"
# Test suite (tests.mk): go test -tags bls12381,secp256k1eth over every package. state/indexer/sink/psql
# starts PostgreSQL through ory/dockertest in TestMain and needs a Docker daemon, so it is excluded offline:
# p2p.TestNetAddressProperties / TestNetAddressReachabilityTo resolve ya.ru through DNS and are skipped offline:
#   CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -count=1 -p 1 -tags bls12381,secp256k1eth -skip 'TestNetAddressProperties|TestNetAddressReachabilityTo' $(go list ./... | grep -v -E '/state/indexer/sink/psql$')

RUN go mod download
# Test suite (Makefile test-integration, minus the k3s cluster CI provisions): go test over pkg/, cmd/, internal/.
# Upstream CI installs k3s only so that a kubeconfig exists; TestPreflightSpecsRead merely parses it, so a
# dummy kubeconfig (never dialed) is baked in. TestCollectHostRunCollectWithTimeout execs `ping`, hence
# iputils-ping (Debian 12 version resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-15). test/e2e creates a kind cluster in
# TestMain and is excluded from the offline run:
#   go test -count=1 -tags 'exclude_graphdriver_devicemapper exclude_graphdriver_btrfs' $(go list ./... | grep -v '/test/e2e')
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends iputils-ping=3:20221126-1+deb12u1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN mkdir -p /root/.kube && printf '%s\n' 'apiVersion: v1' 'kind: Config' \
        'clusters: [{name: dummy, cluster: {server: "https://127.0.0.1:1"}}]' \
        'contexts: [{name: dummy, context: {cluster: dummy, user: dummy}}]' \
        'current-context: dummy' \
        'users: [{name: dummy, user: {token: dummy}}]' > /root/.kube/config
ENV KUBECONFIG=/root/.kube/config

# ---- GTK stack: pdfarranger.core / exporter / metadata import Gtk, Poppler and cairo through PyGObject at
# module level, so the GObject introspection typelibs and a PyGObject build for the mars-base Python 3.12 are
# required for anything but tests/test_exporter_outlines.py (Debian 12 versions resolved in mars-base on
# 2026-09-15; PyGObject <= 3.50 because newer releases need girepository-2.0, which bookworm lacks).
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        gettext=0.21-12 pkg-config=1.8.1-1 libgirepository1.0-dev=1.74.0-3 libcairo2-dev=1.16.0-7 \
        gir1.2-gtk-3.0=3.24.38-2~deb12u3 gir1.2-poppler-0.18=22.12.0-2+deb12u3 gir1.2-handy-1=1.8.1-1 \
        libgtk-3-0=3.24.38-2~deb12u3 adwaita-icon-theme=43-1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "pycairo==1.29.1" "PyGObject==3.50.0" "img2pdf==0.6.3"
# No lockfile upstream: pinned with `uv pip compile (as of 2026-08-30; inputs: setup.py)`,
# i.e. every release newer than the base commit is excluded, resolved for Linux / CPython 3.12
# (the mars-base default interpreter), so the image matches what upstream CI saw at this commit.
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
        "lxml==6.1.2" \
        "packaging==26.3" \
        "pikepdf==10.12.0" \
        "pillow==12.3.0" \
        "python-dateutil==2.9.0.post0" \
        "six==1.17.0" \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps -e . \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir "pytest==9.1.1" \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

# Test suite: upstream CI runs tests/test.py (86 GUI tests driven through dogtail/pyatspi under Xvfb, which
# only exist for Debian's own Python 3.11), tests/test_exporter.py, tests/test_core.py and
# tests/test_exporter_outlines.py. The three non-GUI files run headless here:

bz2e2f90904762ca158c63f45d33530b.smoke: cd /app && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_exporter_outlines.py tests/test_exporter.py tests/test_core.py 2>&1 | tail -n 15

RUN go mod download
# Test suite (Makefile): `go test -tags invariants ./...` plus the objiotracing package with its extra tag.
# CI=1 mirrors GitHub Actions: sstable/rowblk skips three tests that allocate 2-4 GiB when CI is set.
# internal/lint is a lint gate (it `go install`s staticcheck/gcassert at test time and runs them over the
# tree), not a unit test, and is excluded from the offline run. internal/metamorphic forks up to
# GOMAXPROCS child processes; it is run separately with -parallel 2 to bound memory.
ENV CI=1

smoke.native: { go test -count=1 -tags invariants -timeout 20m $(go list ./... | grep -v -E '/internal/(lint|metamorphic)$') && go test -count=1 -tags 'invariants pebble_obj_io_tracing' ./objstorage/objstorageprovider/objiotracing && go test -count=1 -tags invariants -timeout 20m -parallel 2 ./internal/metamorphic; } > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 8 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc

    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
# pyodbc (mssql/fabric connection tests) loads libodbc at import; upstream CI installs unixodbc-dev. The DuckDB
# tests load the tpch, ducklake, iceberg and httpfs/aws (S3 secrets) extensions, which DuckDB downloads on first use, so they are installed
# into the extension cache at image build. Debian 12 versions resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-16.
# (SQLMESH__* env vars are not set in the image: tests/core/test_config.py compares Config objects loaded from the
# environment, and tests/__init__.py already disables analytics.)
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unixodbc=2.3.11-2+deb12u1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN python -c "import duckdb; c=duckdb.connect(); [c.execute('INSTALL '+x) for x in ('tpch','ducklake','iceberg','httpfs','aws')]"
# Test suite (Makefile cicd-test, minus the parts that need engine containers / a JDK):
#   pytest -n 2 -m "(fast or slow) and not pyspark and not isolated and not docker and not remote and not cicdonly" tests
#   pytest -m "isolated and not pyspark" && pytest -m registry_isolation && pytest -m dialect_isolated
# docker/remote-marked tests need the engine containers of tests/core/engine_adapter/integration/docker (or cloud
# credentials); pyspark tests need a JDK; cicdonly runs dbt against real packages.

smoke.native: cd /app && python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 2 -q -m '(fast or slow) and not pyspark and not isolated and not docker and not remote and not cicdonly' tests/core tests/cli tests/utils tests/dbt tests/integrations tests/web tests/lsp 2>&1 | tail -n 15 && python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q -m 'isolated and not pyspark' 2>&1 | tail -n 5 && python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q -m registry_isolation 2>&1 | tail -n 5 && python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q -m dialect_isolated 2>&1 | tail -n 5
smoke.emulated: cd /app && python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 2 -q -m 'fast and not pyspark and not isolated and not docker and not remote and not cicdonly' tests/core/state_sync tests/core/test_scheduler.py tests/core/test_plan_stages.py tests/utils tests/web tests/lsp 2>&1 | tail -n 15

bz2f4a5c4bff8a8261b2edb268690e8c.install_block:
RUN go mod download
# ---- headless display: most packages (root, text/v2, vector, colorm, internal/atlas, ...) run their tests inside
# ebiten.RunGame and need an X display with OpenGL; upstream CI (test.yml) installs the X/GL runtime libraries and
# starts `Xvfb :99`. The same libraries (Mesa llvmpipe software rendering) and an entrypoint that starts Xvfb are
# baked in so the suite runs in an offline container. libasound2 + a null ALSA device let the audio process
# test open a PCM without hardware. Debian 12 versions resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-15.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        xvfb=2:21.1.7-3+deb12u13 libgl1=1.6.0-1 libglx-mesa0=22.3.6-1+deb12u2 libgl1-mesa-dri=22.3.6-1+deb12u2 \
        libx11-6=2:1.8.4-2+deb12u2 libxcursor1=1:1.2.1-1 libxext6=2:1.3.4-1+b1 libxi6=2:1.8-1+b1 \
        libxinerama1=2:1.1.4-3 libxrandr2=2:1.5.2-2+b1 libxrender1=1:0.9.10-1.1 libasound2=1.2.8-1+b1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN printf '%s\n' 'pcm.!default { type null }' 'ctl.!default { type null }' > /etc/asound.conf
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'if [ ! -e /tmp/.X11-unix/X99 ]; then' \
        '  Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 -nolisten tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 &' \
        '  i=0; while [ ! -e /tmp/.X11-unix/X99 ] && [ $i -lt 50 ]; do sleep 0.2; i=$((i+1)); done' \
        'fi' \
        'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/ebiten-entrypoint && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/ebiten-entrypoint
ENV DISPLAY=:99.0
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/ebiten-entrypoint"]
# Test suite (test.yml): go test -shuffle=on -p=1 ./...

smoke.native: go test -count=1 -p=1 -shuffle=on -timeout 30m ./... > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 12 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc
smoke.emulated: go test -count=1 -p=1 -timeout 40m $(go list ./... | grep -v -E '/exp/vmhost$|/internal/processtest$') > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 12 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc

bz2f4a5c4bff8a8261b2edb268690e8c._note: Xvfb + Mesa llvmpipe baked with an entrypoint (as upstream CI); emulated run skips the two packages that build ~20 Ebiten binaries each.
bz2f4a5c4bff8a8261b2edb268690e8c.source_title: 音频播放器支持变速播放

bz065d37885efb0553a1b64dcf069adf.install_block:
RUN go mod download
# Test suite (check.yml): go test ./... . Tests bind 127.0.0.x addresses only, so no network is needed.
# TestSyslogFilter dials the host syslog socket (/dev/log), which a container does not have; upstream CI's
# own gate (CI=true) skips the mDNS test:
#   CI=true go test -count=1 -p 1 ./... -skip 'TestSyslogFilter'
# (-p 1: the gossip tests time out on probe intervals and are sensitive to CPU contention between packages)

smoke.native: CI=true go test -count=1 -p 1 ./... -skip 'TestSyslogFilter' > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 8 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc
smoke.emulated: CI=true go test -count=1 -p 1 ./serf/... ./coordinate/... ./testutil/... -skip 'TestSyslogFilter|TestSnapshotter_leave_rejoin|TestForceLeaveCommandRun_prune' > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 8 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc

bz065d37885efb0553a1b64dcf069adf._note: loopback-only binds; TestSyslogFilter (/dev/log) skipped; CI=true as upstream for the mDNS test. Emulated run additionally skips TestSnapshotter_leave_rejoin (drain race in the test) and TestForceLeaveCommandRun_prune (probe-interval timing), which flake under amd64 emulation. Emulated run limited to serf/coordinate/testutil: the cmd/serf agent tests wait on gossip probe timings and flake under emulation (different test each run); the native run covers everything.
bz065d37885efb0553a1b64dcf069adf.source_title: 可热更新的分权 RPC 令牌

# ---- services: the suite (tests/conftest.py) talks to a Scrapyd at 127.0.0.1:6800 with admin/12345 and reads its
# logs from ~/logs, exactly as .circleci/config.yml starts one. Scrapyd 1.5.0 is installed above and started by the
# entrypoint (or `scrapyd-services` by hand) so the suite runs in an offline container; the demo spiders only
# fail their httpbin requests, which the tests tolerate.
RUN mkdir -p /root/logs /root/eggs /root/dbs /etc/scrapyd \
    && printf '%s\n' '[scrapyd]' 'username = admin' 'password = 12345' 'bind_address = 127.0.0.1' 'http_port = 6800' \
        'logs_dir = /root/logs' 'eggs_dir = /root/eggs' 'dbs_dir = /root/dbs' > /etc/scrapyd/scrapyd.conf \
    && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
        'if ! curl -fs -u admin:12345 http://127.0.0.1:6800/daemonstatus.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then' \
        '  mkdir -p /root/logs; (cd /root && nohup scrapyd >/root/scrapyd.log 2>&1 &)' \
        '  i=0; until curl -fs -u admin:12345 http://127.0.0.1:6800/daemonstatus.json >/dev/null 2>&1; do' \
        '    i=$((i+1)); [ $i -ge 60 ] && { cat /root/scrapyd.log; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done' \
        'fi' > /usr/local/bin/scrapyd-services && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/scrapyd-services \
    && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'scrapyd-services' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/scrapydweb-entrypoint \
    && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/scrapydweb-entrypoint
# tests/conftest.py enables the Slack/Telegram/email alert checks unless these env vars say otherwise; upstream CI
# supplies real tokens through CircleCI secrets, which an offline container cannot use.
ENV SCRAPYDWEB_TESTMODE=True PYTHONUTF8=1 LANG=C.UTF-8 ENABLE_SLACK_ALERT=False ENABLE_TELEGRAM_ALERT=False ENABLE_EMAIL_ALERT=False
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/scrapydweb-entrypoint"]
# Test suite (.circleci/config.yml): python -m pytest tests   (order-dependent; run the directory as a whole)

smoke.native: cd /app && scrapyd-services && python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider --disable-warnings 2>&1 | tail -n 15

bz50e5b0a1fff91c2d368955c03d3600.install_block:
# ---- git >= 2.42: the SHA-256 repository tests (modules/git/*_sha256_test.go, services/repository/files) need
# git's stable SHA-256 support, which Debian 12's git 2.39 lacks (upstream CI runs on ubuntu-latest, git 2.43+).
# git 2.47.3 is built from the kernel.org release tarball (checksum from sha256sums.asc) into /usr/local.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        libcurl4-openssl-dev=7.88.1-10+deb12u15 libexpat1-dev=2.5.0-1+deb12u3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/git.tar.xz https://mirrors.edge.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/git-2.47.3.tar.xz \
    && echo "9c2eb1250781b3e5bfef098572d07fdf132d67e6c065e4307332ade9819a1501  /tmp/git.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c - \
    && mkdir -p /tmp/git-src && tar -xJf /tmp/git.tar.xz -C /tmp/git-src --strip-components=1 \
    && make -C /tmp/git-src -j"$(nproc)" prefix=/usr/local NO_TCLTK=1 NO_GETTEXT=1 NO_PERL=1 install >/dev/null \
    && rm -rf /tmp/git-src /tmp/git.tar.xz && git --version
# ---- module/build caches in a world-readable location: the suite refuses to run as root (Gitea's
# mustNotRunAsRoot), so the tests run as the unprivileged `ci` user created below, as on upstream's CI runner.
ENV GOMODCACHE=/opt/gomod GOCACHE=/opt/gocache
RUN go mod download
# Test suite (pull-db-tests.yml test-unit): `make generate-go` with TAGS=bindata, then `make test-backend`
# (go test -tags bindata over every package except modelmigration/ and tests/integration; unit tests use an
# embedded sqlite database). The bindata packers write gitignored bindata.dat files the embed directives need,
# so they are generated at image build. Upstream's own GITEA_TEST_CI_SKIP_EXTERNAL flag makes the tests that
# need MinIO / Elasticsearch / Meilisearch / Azurite skip instead of failing when CI is set; the Redis-backed
# tests start their own redis-server from PATH (Debian 12 version resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-15).
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends redis-server=5:7.0.15-1~deb12u9 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN TAGS=bindata make generate-go
ENV GITEA_TEST_CI_SKIP_EXTERNAL=true
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 ci && chown -R ci:ci /app && chmod -R a+rwX /opt/gomod /opt/gocache
# services/migrations.TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist resolves gitlab.com/github.com through DNS (the empty allow-list
# falls back to the built-in "external" rule, which needs the resolved addresses); it is skipped offline.
# Offline run (as the ci user):
#   su -p ci -c 'export HOME=/home/ci; cd /app && go test -count=1 -tags bindata -skip 'TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist' $(go list ./... | grep -v /vendor/ | grep -vE "^gitea\.dev/(modelmigration(/|$)|tests$|tests/integration(/|$))")'

smoke.native: { su -p ci -c 'export HOME=/home/ci; cd /app && go test -count=1 -timeout 30m -p 4 -tags bindata -skip 'TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist' $(go list ./... | grep -v /vendor/ | grep -vE "^gitea\.dev/(modelmigration(/|$)|tests$|tests/integration(/|$))")'; } > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 12 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc
smoke.emulated: { su -p ci -c 'export HOME=/home/ci; cd /app && go test -count=1 -timeout 30m -p 2 -tags bindata -skip 'TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist' ./models/... ./modules/...'; } > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 12 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc

bz50e5b0a1fff91c2d368955c03d3600._note: git 2.47.3 built from source (sha256 repos); tests run as non-root ci user (gitea refuses root; GITEA_* env is cleared by the test env so the escape-hatch var does not work); bindata generated; redis baked. TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist (DNS) skipped.
bz50e5b0a1fff91c2d368955c03d3600.source_title: 仓库转移并发终态的一致收敛

bz8c172dfa248adf818edc11c23e8254.install_block:
# ---- git >= 2.42: the SHA-256 repository tests (modules/git/*_sha256_test.go, services/repository/files) need
# git's stable SHA-256 support, which Debian 12's git 2.39 lacks (upstream CI runs on ubuntu-latest, git 2.43+).
# git 2.47.3 is built from the kernel.org release tarball (checksum from sha256sums.asc) into /usr/local.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        libcurl4-openssl-dev=7.88.1-10+deb12u15 libexpat1-dev=2.5.0-1+deb12u3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/git.tar.xz https://mirrors.edge.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/git-2.47.3.tar.xz \
    && echo "9c2eb1250781b3e5bfef098572d07fdf132d67e6c065e4307332ade9819a1501  /tmp/git.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c - \
    && mkdir -p /tmp/git-src && tar -xJf /tmp/git.tar.xz -C /tmp/git-src --strip-components=1 \
    && make -C /tmp/git-src -j"$(nproc)" prefix=/usr/local NO_TCLTK=1 NO_GETTEXT=1 NO_PERL=1 install >/dev/null \
    && rm -rf /tmp/git-src /tmp/git.tar.xz && git --version
# ---- module/build caches in a world-readable location: the suite refuses to run as root (Gitea's
# mustNotRunAsRoot), so the tests run as the unprivileged `ci` user created below, as on upstream's CI runner.
ENV GOMODCACHE=/opt/gomod GOCACHE=/opt/gocache
RUN go mod download
# Test suite (pull-db-tests.yml test-unit): `make generate-go` with TAGS=bindata, then `make test-backend`
# (go test -tags bindata over every package except modelmigration/ and tests/integration; unit tests use an
# embedded sqlite database). The bindata packers write gitignored bindata.dat files the embed directives need,
# so they are generated at image build. Upstream's own GITEA_TEST_CI_SKIP_EXTERNAL flag makes the tests that
# need MinIO / Elasticsearch / Meilisearch / Azurite skip instead of failing when CI is set; the Redis-backed
# tests start their own redis-server from PATH (Debian 12 version resolved in mars-base on 2026-09-15).
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends redis-server=5:7.0.15-1~deb12u9 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN TAGS=bindata make generate-go
ENV GITEA_TEST_CI_SKIP_EXTERNAL=true
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 ci && chown -R ci:ci /app && chmod -R a+rwX /opt/gomod /opt/gocache
# services/migrations.TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist resolves gitlab.com/github.com through DNS (the empty allow-list
# falls back to the built-in "external" rule, which needs the resolved addresses); it is skipped offline.
# Offline run (as the ci user):
#   su -p ci -c 'export HOME=/home/ci; cd /app && go test -count=1 -tags bindata -skip 'TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist' $(go list ./... | grep -v /vendor/ | grep -vE "^gitea\.dev/(modelmigration(/|$)|tests$|tests/integration(/|$))")'

smoke.native: { su -p ci -c 'export HOME=/home/ci; cd /app && go test -count=1 -timeout 30m -p 4 -tags bindata -skip 'TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist' $(go list ./... | grep -v /vendor/ | grep -vE "^gitea\.dev/(modelmigration(/|$)|tests$|tests/integration(/|$))")'; } > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 12 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc
smoke.emulated: { su -p ci -c 'export HOME=/home/ci; cd /app && go test -count=1 -timeout 30m -p 2 -tags bindata -skip 'TestMigrateWhiteBlocklist' ./models/... ./modules/...'; } > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 12 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc

bz4a778b2f5ff6b13884c71b4b0f1bbf.install_block:
# The editable install runs yarl's own PEP 517 backend (packaging/pep517_backend), which cythonizes and compiles
# yarl/_quoting_c in-tree; it is run without build isolation so the pinned cython/expandvars/setuptools are used
# (setuptools 80.9 = the mars-base release).
# No lockfile upstream: pinned with `uv pip compile (as of 2026-09-14; inputs: pyproject.toml, requirements/dev.txt, requirements/test.txt)`,
# i.e. every release newer than the base commit is excluded, resolved for Linux / CPython 3.12

bz3e8d35aeba1985315946f71da8b602.install_block:
RUN go mod download
# Test suite (tests.yaml → scripts/runTestsOnTravis.sh): the server package is split into ~14 CI jobs of up to 30 min
# each (`go test -p=1 -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=30m` with skip_* build tags and -run filters). A single offline
# run cannot hold all of them; the smoke runs the JetStream source/mirror tests (the task's area, non-cluster) and the
# options/config/monitor tests plus ./conf and ./internal, with the same flags and tag sets as CI:
#   go test ./server -p=1 -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=25m -tags=skip_js_cluster_tests,skip_js_cluster_tests_2,skip_js_cluster_tests_3,skip_js_cluster_tests_4,skip_js_super_cluster_tests,skip_js_consumer_tests,skip_store_tests,skip_mqtt_tests,skip_msgtrace_tests,skip_no_race_tests -run '^TestJetStream.*(Source|Mirror|Sourcing)'
#   go test ./server -p=1 -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=15m -tags=skip_store_tests,skip_js_tests,skip_mqtt_tests,skip_msgtrace_tests,skip_no_race_tests -run '^Test(Options|Config|JetStreamConfig|Monitor|Varz|Streamz)' && go test ./conf/... ./internal/... -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=5m
# The server advertises its non-loopback addresses (TestConfigReloadClusterAdvertise, TestGetConnectURLs): the
# container needs a network interface (no route out is required); under `--network none` those tests fail.
# BUILDKITE=true is the repo's own gate for the two filestore chmod tests that cannot fail as root.
ENV BUILDKITE=true
# Warm the build cache for the tag sets above so the offline run does not spend its budget compiling.
RUN go test -run='^$' -count=1 -vet=off -tags=skip_js_cluster_tests,skip_js_cluster_tests_2,skip_js_cluster_tests_3,skip_js_cluster_tests_4,skip_js_super_cluster_tests,skip_js_consumer_tests,skip_store_tests,skip_mqtt_tests,skip_msgtrace_tests,skip_no_race_tests ./server >/dev/null && go test -run='^$' -count=1 -vet=off -tags=skip_store_tests,skip_js_tests,skip_mqtt_tests,skip_msgtrace_tests,skip_no_race_tests ./server ./conf/... ./internal/... >/dev/null

smoke.native: { go test ./server -p=1 -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=25m -tags=skip_js_cluster_tests,skip_js_cluster_tests_2,skip_js_cluster_tests_3,skip_js_cluster_tests_4,skip_js_super_cluster_tests,skip_js_consumer_tests,skip_store_tests,skip_mqtt_tests,skip_msgtrace_tests,skip_no_race_tests -run '^TestJetStream.*(Source|Mirror|Sourcing)' && go test ./server -p=1 -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=15m -tags=skip_store_tests,skip_js_tests,skip_mqtt_tests,skip_msgtrace_tests,skip_no_race_tests -run '^Test(Options|Config|JetStreamConfig|Monitor|Varz|Streamz)' && go test ./conf/... ./internal/... -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=5m; } > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 12 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc
smoke.emulated: { go test ./server -p=1 -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=15m -tags=skip_store_tests,skip_js_tests,skip_mqtt_tests,skip_msgtrace_tests,skip_no_race_tests -run '^Test(Options|Config|JetStreamConfig|Monitor|Varz|Streamz)' && go test ./conf/... ./internal/... -count=1 -vet=off -timeout=5m; } > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 12 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc

bz3e8d35aeba1985315946f71da8b602._note: CI splits are 14×30 min; smoke = JetStream source/mirror (non-cluster) + options/config/monitor + conf/internal with CI flags/tags; BUILDKITE=true skips two chmod tests. smoke_network=internal (advertise tests need a NIC).

bz89fe7814c2da30b5faaeb8be3a634b.install_block:
# ---- qualified Node.js runtime: the SQLite authority runtime (loopx/control_plane/coordination/sqlite_runtime.ts)
# refuses node:sqlite builds without the WAL-reset fix (needs SQLite 3.50.7+/3.51.3+/3.44.6+) and names Node 22.22.3
# as the qualified runtime, which upstream CI installs for those jobs; mars-base's Node 24.12 bundles SQLite 3.50.4.
# Official nodejs.org tarball, checksums from SHASUMS256.txt.
RUN set -e; case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64) a=arm64; sum=1c4a9933a5e45bc88f54f70b5f91232c127ec49f1a5989d23fb85824c7adf9b7;; x86_64) a=x64; sum=2e5d13569282d016861fae7c8f935e741693c269101a5bebcf761a5376d1f99f;; *) echo "unsupported arch" && exit 1;; esac; \
    curl -fsSL -o /tmp/node.tar.xz "https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.22.3/node-v22.22.3-linux-$a.tar.xz" \
    && echo "$sum  /tmp/node.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c - \
    && mkdir -p /opt/node && tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /opt/node --strip-components=1 && rm /tmp/node.tar.xz
ENV PATH="/opt/node/bin:${PATH}"
# The workspace guard (loopx/control_plane/agents/workspace_guard.py) identifies a checkout by its `origin` remote;
# the template above removes origin after the checkout, so the upstream URL is registered again as a plain remote

bz428823f43b981487b6c79112911d71.install_block:
# CI (noxfile.py github-cext-greenlet) installs the tests, tests-greenlet (greenlet) and tests-sqlite-asyncio (aiosqlite)
# dependency groups and requires the Cython extensions to build (REQUIRE_SQLALCHEMY_CEXT=1).
# No lockfile upstream: pinned with `uv pip compile (as of 2026-09-13; inputs: pyproject.toml, .swepipe-extra-requirements.txt; group tests)`,
# i.e. every release newer than the base commit is excluded, resolved for Linux / CPython 3.12
# (the mars-base default interpreter), so the image matches what upstream CI saw at this commit.
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
        "aiosqlite==0.22.1" \
        "greenlet==3.5.6" \
        "execnet==2.1.2" \
        "iniconfig==2.3.0" \
        "packaging==26.3" \
        "pluggy==1.6.0" \
        "pygments==2.21.0" \
        "pytest-xdist==3.8.0" \
        "pytest==9.1.1" \
        "typing-extensions==4.16.0" \
    && REQUIRE_SQLALCHEMY_CEXT=1 pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps -e . \
    && python -c "from sqlalchemy.util._has_cython import HAS_CYEXTENSION; assert HAS_CYEXTENSION" \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

# Test suite (noxfile.py): pytest -n4 --db=sqlite --dbdriver=sqlite --dbdriver=pysqlite_numeric --dbdriver=aiosqlite
#   -m "not memory_intensive and not mypy and not timing_intensive"   (other databases are opt-in via --db)
bz428823f43b981487b6c79112911d71.smoke: cd /app && python -m pytest test -n2 --max-worker-restart=5 --db sqlite --dbdriver sqlite --dbdriver pysqlite_numeric --dbdriver aiosqlite -m 'not memory_intensive and not mypy and not timing_intensive' -p no:cacheprovider -q 2>&1 | tail -n 5
bz428823f43b981487b6c79112911d71._note: CI cext-greenlet variant: greenlet+aiosqlite pinned, Cython ext required; sqlite suite (~29k tests, minutes).

        "aiosqlite==0.22.1" \

        "asyncmy==0.2.14" \
        "asyncpg==0.31.0" \
        "attrs==26.1.0" \
        "cffi==2.1.1" \
        "coverage==7.16.1" \
        "cryptography==50.0.1" \
        "dnspython==2.8.0" \
        "greenlet==3.5.6" \
        "idna==3.19" \
        "iniconfig==2.3.0" \
        "outcome==1.3.0.post0" \
        "packaging==26.3" \
        "pluggy==1.6.0" \
        "psycopg-binary==3.3.5" \
        "psycopg==3.3.5" \
        "pycparser==3.0" \
        "pygments==2.21.0" \
        "pymongo==4.18.1" \
        "pymysql==1.2.0" \


        "pytest-lazy-fixtures==1.4.1" \
        "pytest-mock==3.15.1" \
        "pytest==9.0.3" \
        "redis==8.1.0" \
        "sniffio==1.3.1" \
        "sortedcontainers==2.4.0" \
        "sqlalchemy==2.0.54" \
        "tenacity==9.1.4" \
        "time-machine==3.5.1" \
        "trio==0.34.0" \
        "typing-extensions==4.16.0" \
        "tzlocal==5.4.4" \

    && pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps -e . \
